Package raft 实现固定 3 节点 Raft 的选举与日志复制核心逻辑。\n//\n// 本包不含任何真实网络、定时器协程或磁盘 IO：节点只通过 Environment\n// 接口与外部（确定性离散事件模拟器）交互，因此节点逻辑可以在单进程内\n// 被确定性地驱动。持久化的任期、投票与日志通过 Storage 接口落盘。\npackage raft\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/rand\"\n\t\"sync\"\n)\n\n// Role 为节点角色。\ntype Role int\n\nconst (\n\tFollower Role = iota\n\tCandidate\n\tLeader\n)\n\nfunc (r Role) String() string {\n\tswitch r {\n\tcase Candidate:\n\t\treturn \"candidate\"\n\tcase Leader:\n\t\treturn \"leader\"\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn \"follower\"\n\t}\n}\n\n// Entry 是一条日志条目。ClientID 为模拟器中发起写入的标识，用于把\n// 复制结果回传给对应客户端请求；索引为 1 起。\ntype Entry struct {\n\tTerm     int    `json:\"term\"`\n\tCommand  string `json:\"command\"`\n\tClientID string `json:\"clientId,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// MessageType 为节点间消息类型。\ntype MessageType int\n\nconst (\n\tMsgApp       MessageType = iota // 领导者的追加日志（兼心跳）\n\tMsgAppResp                      // 追加日志响应\n\tMsgVote                         // 候选人的拉票\n\tMsgVoteResp                     // 投票响应\n)\n\n// Message 是节点间的内部消息（不直接序列化为线路格式）。\ntype Message struct {\n\tType       MessageType\n\tFrom       int\n\tTo         int\n\tTerm       int // 发送者当前任期\n\tPrevLogIdx int\n\tPrevLogTerm int\n\tEntries    []Entry // MsgApp 携带的新条目\n\tLeaderCommit int    // MsgApp 中领导者的 commitIndex\n\tGrant      bool    // 投票响应\n\tSuccess    bool    // 追加响应\n\tMatchIndex int     // 追加成功时接收者的最新索引\n}\n\n// Config 是单个节点使用的时序参数（单位由模拟器定义，本项目为毫秒）。\ntype Config struct {\n\tID              int\n\tPeers           []int\n\tHeartbeatPeriod int\n\tElectionMin     int // 随机选举超时下界（含）\n\tElectionMax     int // 随机选举超时上界（含）\n}\n\n// Environment 是节点与确定性模拟器之间的全部交互面。\ntype Environment interface {\n\tNow() int64\n\tSend(m Message)\n\t// ScheduleElection 在随机选举超时后触发一次选举检查；\n\t// 节点每次收到合法心跳/投票或启动时都会重新排程。\n\tScheduleElection(deadline int64)\n\t// ScheduleHeartbeat 在给定时刻触发一次心跳广播（仅领导者）。\n\tScheduleHeartbeat(deadline int64)\n}\n\n// Node 是一个 Raft 节点的全部内存状态。\ntype Node struct {\n\tmu     sync.Mutex\n\tcfg    Config\n\tenv    Environment\n\trng    *rand.Rand\n\tstore  Storage\n\n\t// 持久化状态（每次修改后同步落盘）\n\tCurrentTerm int\n\tVotedFor    int // 0 表示本任期尚未投票\n\tLog         []Entry // Log[0] 为哨兵，真实条目索引 = 切片下标\n\n\t// 易失状态\n\trole        Role\n\tcommitIndex int\n\tlastApplied int\n\tleaderID    int\n\n\t// 领导者易失状态（按节点 ID 索引）\n\tnextIndex  map[int]int\n\tmatchIndex map[int]int\n\n\t// 本节点上尚未被确认提交的客户端写入\n\tpending map[string]int // clientID -> 本地索引\n}\n\n// NewNode 创建一个节点：若磁盘上已有持久化状态则恢复（模拟重启），\n// 否则以初始跟随者身份启动。两种情况都会重新排程选举定时器。\nfunc NewNode(cfg Config, env Environment, store Storage, rng *rand.Rand) *Node {\n\tn := &Node{\n\t\tcfg:        cfg,\n\t\tenv:        env,\n\t\trng:        rng,\n\t\tstore:      store,\n\t\tVotedFor:   0,\n\t\tLog:        []Entry{{Term: 0}},\n\t\tnextIndex:  make(map[int]int),\n\t\tmatchIndex: make(map[int]int),\n\t\tpending:    make(map[string]int),\n\t}\n\tif ps, err := store.Load(); err == nil && ps != nil {\n\t\tn.CurrentTerm = ps.CurrentTerm\n\t\tn.VotedFor = ps.VotedFor\n\t\tif len(ps.Log) > 0 {\n\t\t\tn.Log = ps.Log\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tn.resetElectionTimer()\n\treturn n\n}\n\n// ---- 持久化辅助 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) persist() {\n\t// 模拟器单线程驱动；持久化失败属于致命错误，直接 panic 暴露问题。\n\tif err := n.store.Save(PersistentState{\n\t\tCurrentTerm: n.CurrentTerm,\n\t\tVotedFor:    n.VotedFor,\n\t\tLog:         n.Log,\n\t}); err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- 日志索引辅助 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) lastIndex() int {\n\treturn len(n.Log) - 1\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) termAt(idx int) int {\n\tif idx < 0 || idx >= len(n.Log) {\n\t\treturn -1\n\t}\n\treturn n.Log[idx].Term\n}\n\n// ---- 定时器 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) resetElectionTimer() {\n\tspan := n.cfg.ElectionMax - n.cfg.ElectionMin + 1\n\td := n.cfg.ElectionMin\n\tif span > 1 {\n\t\td += n.rng.Intn(span)\n\t}\n\tn.env.ScheduleElection(n.env.Now() + int64(d))\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) scheduleHeartbeat() {\n\tn.env.ScheduleHeartbeat(n.env.Now() + int64(n.cfg.HeartbeatPeriod))\n}\n\n// ---- 角色转换 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) becomeFollower(term int) {\n\tif term > n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\tn.CurrentTerm = term\n\t\tn.VotedFor = 0\n\t\tn.persist()\n\t}\n\tn.role = Follower\n\tn.leaderID = 0\n\tn.resetElectionTimer()\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) becomeCandidate() {\n\tn.CurrentTerm++\n\tn.role = Candidate\n\tn.VotedFor = n.cfg.ID\n\tn.leaderID = 0\n\tn.persist()\n\n\tvotes := 1\n\tfor _, p := range n.cfg.Peers {\n\t\tif p == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.env.Send(Message{\n\t\t\tType: n.lastIndex()\n\tfor _, p := range n.cfg.Peers {\n\t\tif p == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.nextIndex[p] = last + 1\n\t\tn.matchIndex[p] = 0\n\t}\n\t// 立即发一轮心跳以宣告主权。\n\tn.broadcastAppend()\n\tn.scheduleHeartbeat()\n}\n\n// ---- 外部入口 ----\n\n// Step 处理一条到达本节点的消息。\nfunc (n *Node) Step(m Message) {\n\tswitch m.Type {\n\tcase false\n\t}\n\tn.Log = append(n.Log, Entry{\n\t\tTerm:     n.CurrentTerm,\n\t\tCommand:  command,\n\t\tClientID: clientID,\n\t})\n\tn.pending[clientID] = n.lastIndex()\n\tn.persist()\n\tn.matchIndex[n.cfg.ID] = n.lastIndex()\n\t// 立刻并行追加，不必等待心跳。\n\tn.broadcastAppend()\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// ---- 日志复制 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) broadcastAppend() {\n\tfor _, p := range n.cfg.Peers {\n\t\tif p == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.sendAppend(p)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) sendAppend(to int) {\n\tnext := n.nextIndex[to]\n\tprevIdx := next - 1\n\tm := Message{\n\t\tType:         MsgApp,\n\t\tFrom:         n.cfg.ID,\n\t\tTo:           to,\n\t\tTerm:         n.CurrentTerm,\n\t\tPrevLogIdx:   prevIdx,\n\t\tPrevLogTerm:  n.termAt(prevIdx),\n\t\tLeaderCommit: n.commitIndex,\n\t}\n\tif next <= n.lastIndex() {\n\t\tm.Entries = append([]Entry(nil), n.Log[next:]...)\n\t}\n\tn.env.Send(m)\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) onAppend(m {\n\t\t\t\tcount++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif count*2 > len(n.cfg.Peers) {\n\t\t\tn.commitIndex = idx\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- 选举 ----\n\n// logUpToDate 实现 Raft 的候选人日志新旧比较：先比最后条目任期，\n// {\n\t\tn.env.Send(Message{Type: MsgVoteResp, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.From,\n\t\t\tTerm: n.CurrentTerm, Grant: grant})\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) onVoteResp(m Message) {\n\tif m.Term > n.CurrentTerm {"parentUuid":"fb3332e0-9816-408a-89e2-7e82a78733fd","isSidechain":false,"message":{"content":[{"id":"call_d4cvxld5p72k5klqi0w4ak9l","input":{"file_path":"/home/admin/Downloads/biaozhul/opp21/b/internal/raft/storage.go","content":"package raft\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"errors\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"os\"\n\t\"path/filepath\"\n)\n\n// PersistentState 是 Raft 必须在响应前落盘的全部状态。\ntype PersistentState struct {\n\tCurrentTerm int     `json:\"currentTerm\"`\n\tVotedFor    int     `json:\"votedFor\"`\n\tLog         []Entry `json:\"log\"`\n}\n\n// Storage 抽象节点的持久化存储，使得“崩溃-重启”可以从磁盘恢复，\n// 也便于测试时替换为内存实现。\ntype Storage interface {\n\tLoad() (*PersistentState, error)\n\tSave(PersistentState) error\n\t// Reset 清除全部持久化状态（模拟器初始化一个全新集群时使用）。\n\tReset() error\n}\n\n// FileStorage 把状态以 JSON 写入 <dir>/state.json，\n// 采用“临时文件 + rename”保证单次保存的原子性。\ntype FileStorage struct {\n\tpath string\n}\n\nfunc NewFileStorage(dir string) (*FileStorage, error) {\n\tif err := os.MkdirAll(dir, 0o755); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"create state dir %q: %w\", dir, err)\n\t}\n\treturn &FileStorage{path: filepath.Join(dir, \"state.json\")}, nil\n}\n\nfunc (s *FileStorage) Load() (*PersistentState, error) {\n\tdata, err := os.ReadFile(s.path)\n\tif errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, err\n\t}\n\tvar ps PersistentState\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &ps); err != nil {\n\t\treturn nil, fmt.Errorf(\"corrupt state file %q: %w\", s.path, err)\n\t}\n\treturn &ps, nil\n}\n\nfunc (s *FileStorage) Save(ps PersistentState) error {\n\tdata, err := json.MarshalIndent(ps, \"\", \"  \")\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\ttmp := s.path + \".tmp\"\n\tif err := os.WriteFile(tmp, data, 0o644); err != nil {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\treturn os.Rename(tmp, s.path)\n}\n\nfunc (s *FileStorage) Reset() error {\n\tif err := os.Remove(s.path); err != nil && !errors.Is(err, os.ErrNotExist) {\n\t\treturn err\n\t}\n\tif err := os.Remove(s.path + \".tmp\"); Package sim 是 Raft 节点的确定性离散事件模拟器。\n//\n// 模拟器维护一个按 (时间, 序号) 排序的事件队列，驱动固定 3 个 Raft\n// 节点在单进程内运行；节点之间不直接通信，所有消息都经过可丢包、\n// 重复和乱序的虚拟网络。场景通过 JSON 描述，见 examples/ 目录。\npackage sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n)\n\n// Scenario 是一次模拟运行的完整输入。\ntype Scenario struct {\n\tName      string     `json:\"name\"`\n\tNodeCount int        `json:\"nodeCount\"` // 必须为 3\n\tSeed      int64      `json:\"seed\"`\n\tTick      int64      `json:\"tick\"`      // 时间单位（毫秒），仅用于文档化\n\tEndTime   int64      `json:\"endTime\"`   // 模拟在此时刻停止（含此时刻之前投递的事件）\n\tHeartbeat int        `json:\"heartbeat\"` // 心跳周期（毫秒）\n\tElection  TimeRange  `json:\"electionTimeout\"`\n\tNetwork   NetworkCfg `json:\"network\"`\n\t// DataDir 为持久化目录；运行开始时清除其中的节点状态文件，\n\t// 运行过程中的 restart 事件从同一目录恢复。\n\tDataDir string          `json:\"dataDir\"`\n\tTrace   bool            `json:\"trace\"`\n\tEvents  []ScenarioEvent `json:\"events\"`\n}\n\n// TimeRange 是随机选举超时的闭区间。\ntype TimeRange struct {\n\tMin int `json:\"min\"`\n\tMax int `json:\"max\"`\n}\n\n// NetworkCfg 描述虚拟网络的默认行为。\ntype NetworkCfg struct {\n\tBaseDelay int64   `json:\"baseDelay\"` // 每条消息的基础时延（毫秒）\n\tJitterPct float64 `json:\"jitterPct\"` // 相对基础时延的随机抖动比例，制造乱序\n\tLossPct   float64 `json:\"lossPct\"`   // 每条消息的独立丢包概率\n\tDupPct    float64 `json:\"dupPct\"`    // 每条消息额外复制一份的概率\n}\n\n// ScenarioEvent 是脚本中的一个外部事件。\ntype ScenarioEvent struct {\n\tTime    int64    `json:\"time\"`\n\tType    string   `json:\"type\"`    // client | crash | restart | partition | heal | link\n\tNode    *NodeRef `json:\"node\"`    // client/crash/restart 的目标节点\n\tClient  string   `json:\"client\"`  // client: 客户端请求标识\n\tCommand string   `json:\"command\"` // client: 写入内容\n\tGroups  [][]int  `json:\"groups\"`  // partition: 分区分组\n\tFrom    int      `json:\"from\"`    // link\n\tTo      int      `json:\"to\"`      // link\n\tLoss    *float64 `json:\"loss\"`    // link: 覆盖丢包率；nil 表示不修改\n\tDup     *float64 `json:\"dup\"`     // link: 覆盖重复率\n\tBlock   *bool    `json:\"block\"`   // link: 是否完全断开\n}\n\n// NodeRef 支持在脚本里写节点号 (1/2/3) 或 \"leader\"（当前领导者）。\ntype NodeRef struct {\n\tID    int\n\tLeader bool\n}\n\nfunc (r *NodeRef) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {\n\tvar s string\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &s); == nil {\n\t\tif s == \"leader\" {\n\t\t\tr.Leader = true\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tid, err := strconv.Atoi(s)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node ref must be 1..3 or \\\"leader\\\", got %q\", s)\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.ID = id\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tvar n int\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &n); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node ref must be 1..3 or \\\"leader\\\", got %s\", string(data))\n\t}\n\tr.ID = n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (s *Scenario) validate() error {\n\tif s.NodeCount != 3 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"nodeCount must be 3 (fixed membership), got %d\", s.NodeCount)\n\t}\n\tif s.EndTime <= 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"endTime must be positive\")\n\t}\n\tif s.Heartbeat <= 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"heartbeat must be positive\")\n\t}\n\tif s.Election.Min <= 0 || s.Election.Max < s.Election.Min {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"invalid electionTimeout: %+v\", s.Election)\n\t}\n\tif s.Election.Min <= s.Heartbeat {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"electionTimeout.min (%d) must be greater than heartbeat (%d)\",\n\t\t\ts.Election.Min, s.Heartbeat)\n\t}\n\tn := s.Network\n\tif n.LossPct < 0 || n.LossPct > 1 || n.DupPct < 0 || n.DupPct > 1 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"network loss/dup probabilities must be within [0,1]\")\n\t}\n\tif n.JitterPct < 0 || n.JitterPct > 1 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"network jitterPct must be within [0,1]\")\n\t}\n\tvalid := map[string]bool{\n\t\t\"client\": true, \"crash\": true, \"restart\": true,\n\t\t\"partition\": true, \"heal\": true, \"link\": true,\n\t}\n\tfor i, e := range s.Events {\n\t\tif !valid[e.Type] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: unknown type %q\", i, e.Type)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif e.Time < 0 || e.Time > s.EndTime {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: time %d out of range [0,%d]\", i, e.Time, s.EndTime)\n\t\t}\n\t\tswitch e.Type {\n\t\tcase \"client\":\n\t\t\tif e.Node == nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: client event needs node\", i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif e.Client == \"\" {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: client event needs client id\", i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"crash\", \"restart\":\n\t\t\tif e.Node == nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: %s event needs node\", i, e.Type)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"partition\":\n\t\t\tif len(e.Groups) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: partition event needs groups\", i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"link\":\n\t\t\tif e.From == 0 || e.To == 0 {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: link event needs from/to\", i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn nil\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_5469e8131b4d6a215adcb78e","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":1203,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":48952,"output_tokens":1726,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_e8flzi2bk049xxxisn6uzju1":{"content":"//         // 某节点心跳周期\n)\n\ntype event struct {\n\ttime int64\n\tseq  int64 // 同刻 FIFO 序号，保证确定性\n\tkind eventKind\n\tnode int    // evElection / evHeartbeat 所属节点\n\tepoch int64 // &delayedMsg{from: from, to: to, payload: msg, dup: dup},\n\t})\n}\n\n// mainLoop 是离散事件主循环。\nfunc (s *Simulator) mainLoop() {\n\tfor {\n\t\tev := s.q.pop()\n\t\tif ev == nil {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\tif ev.time > s.sc.EndTime {\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t\ts.time = ev.time\n\t\tswitch ev.kind {\n\t\tcase {\n\t\t\t\ts.recordTrace(TraceEvent{Time: s.time, Kind: \"drop\", From: dm.from, To: dm.to, Detail: \"node down\"})\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tlink := s.links[[2]int{dm.from, dm.to}]\n\t\t\tif link == nil || link.blocked {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tnr.node.Step(dm.payload.(raft.Message))\n\t\tcase evElection:\n\t\t\tnr := s.nodes[ev.node]\n\t\t\tif nr.alive && nr.epoch == ev.epoch {\n\t\t\t\tnr.node.ElectionTick()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase evHeartbeat:\n\t\t\tnr := s.nodes[ev.node]\n\t\t\tif nr.alive && nr.epoch == ev.epoch {\n\t\t\t\tnr.node.HeartbeatTick()\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif ev.kind != evExternal {\n\t\t\ts.observe()\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// resolveRef 把 \"leader\"/节点号 解析为当前节点 ID（0 表示无）。\nfunc (s *Simulator) resolveRef(ref *NodeRef) int {\n\tif ref == nil {\n\t\treturn 0\n\t}\n\tif ref.Leader {\n\t\tfor id := 1; id <= 3; id++ {\n\t\t\tnr := s.nodes[id]\n\t\t\tif nr.alive {\n\t\t\t\tsnap := nr.node.Inspect()\n\t\t\t\tif snap.Role == raft.Leader {\n\t\t\t\t\treturn id\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn 0\n\t}\n\treturn ref.ID\n}\n\n// handleExternal 执行脚本事件。\nfunc (s *Simulator) handleExternal(e *ScenarioEvent) {\n\tswitch e.Type {\n\tcase \"client\":\n\t\ts.handleClient(e)\n\tcase \"crash\":\n\t\tid := s.resolveRef(e.Node)\n\t\tif nr := s.nodes[id]; nr != nil && nr.alive {\n\t\t\tnr.alive = false\n\t\t\tnr.epoch++ // 使在途定时器全部失效\n\t\t\ts.recordTrace(TraceEvent{Time: s.time, Kind: \"crash\", To: id})\n\t\t}\n\tcase \"restart\":\n\t\ts.handleRestart(e)\n\tcase \"partition\":\n\t\ts.handlePartition(e)\n\tcase \"heal\":\n\t\ts.handleHeal()\n\tcase \"link\":\n\t\ts.applyLink(e.From, e.To, e)\n\t\ts.applyLink(e.To, e.From, e)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (s *Simulator) handleClient(e *ScenarioEvent) {\n\tid := s.resolveRef(e.Node)\n\tres := ProposalResult{Client: e.Client, Node: id, Command: e.Command}\n\tnr := s.nodes[id]\n\tif id == 0 || nr == nil || !nr.alive {\n\t\tres.Status = \"nodeDown\"\n\t\ts.proposals = append(s.proposals, res)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tsnap := nr.node.Inspect()\n\tif snap.Role != raft.Leader {\n\t\tres.Status = \"notLeader\"\n\t\ts.proposals = snap.Term\n\t} else {\n\t\tres.Status = \"notLeader\"\n\t}\n\ts.proposals = append(s.proposals, res)\n}\n\nfunc (s *Simulator) handleRestart(e *ScenarioEvent) {\n\tid := s.resolveRef(e.Node)\n\tif id == 0 {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tnr := s.nodes[id]\n\tif nr != nil && nr.alive {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\t// 复用同一磁盘目录：NewNode 会从文件恢复任期/投票/日志。\n\tstore, err := raft.NewFileStorage(nr.dataDir)\n\tif err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n\ts.startNode(id, store)\n\ts.recordTrace(TraceEvent{Time: s.time, Kind: \"restart\", To: id})\n}\n\n// handlePartition 按分组断开所有跨组有向链路。\nfunc (s *Simulator) handlePartition(e *ScenarioEvent) {\n\tgroupOf := map[int]int{}\n\tfor gi, g := range e.Groups {\n\t\tfor _, id := range g {\n\t\t\tgroupOf[id] = gi\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tfor a := 1; a <= 3; a++ {\n\t\tfor b := 1; b <= 3; b++ {\n\t\t\tif a == b {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tga, oka := groupOf[a]\n\t\t\tgb, okb := groupOf[b]\n\t\t\tif oka && okb && ga != gb {\n\t\t\t\tif l := s.links[[2]int{a, b}]; l != nil {\n\t\t\t\t\tl.blocked = true\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\ts.recordTrace(TraceEvent{Time: s.time, Kind: \"partition\"})\n}\n\nfunc (s *Simulator) handleHeal() {\n\tfor _, l := range s.links {\n\t\tl.blocked = false\n\t}\n\ts.recordTrace(TraceEvent{Time: s.time, Kind: \"heal\"})\n}\n\nfunc (s *Simulator) applyLink(from, to int, e *ScenarioEvent) {\n\tl := s.links[[2]int{from, to}]\n\tif l {\n\t\tfor bi := ai + 1; bi < len(alive); bi++ {\n\t\t\tx, y := views[alive[ai]], views[alive[bi]]\n\t\t\tlimit := len(x.log)\n\t\t\tif len(y.log) < limit {\n\t\t\t\tlimit = at index %d (same term %d): node %d cmd=%q vs node %d cmd=%q\",\n\t\t\t\t\t\tidx, x.log[idx].Term, alive[ai], x.log[idx].Command,\n\t\t\t\t\t\talive[bi], y.log[idx].Command)\n\t\t\t\t}\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\n\t// 3) 被报告为 committed 的客户端写入，必须真的在全局已提交前缀中。\n\tfor _, p := range s.proposals {\n\t\tif p.Status != \"committed\" {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\te, ok := s.globalCommitted[p.Index]\n\t\tif !ok {\n\t\t\taddErr(\"proposal %q reported committed at index %d but missing from global prefix\",\n\t\t\t\tp.Client, p.Index)\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tif e.Command != p.Command {\n\t\t\taddErr(\"proposal %q committed command mismatch: %q vs %q\",\n\t\t\t\tp.Client, p.Command, e.Command)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\treturn check\n}\n\n// buildResult 汇总最终结果。\nfunc (s *Simulator) buildResult() *Result {\n\tr := &Result{\n\t\tName:            s.sc.Name,\n\t\tEndTime:         s.time,\n\t\tAliveNodes: (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n)\n\n// Scenario 是一次模拟运行的完整输入。\ntype Scenario struct {\n\tName      string     `json:\"name\"`\n\tNodeCount int        `json:\"nodeCount\"` // 必须为 3\n\tSeed      int64      `json:\"seed\"`\n\tTick      int64      `json:\"tick\"`      // 时间单位（毫秒），仅用于文档化\n\tEndTime   int64      `json:\"endTime\"`   // 模拟在此时刻停止（含此时刻之前投递的事件）\n\tHeartbeat int        `json:\"heartbeat\"` // 心跳周期（毫秒）\n\tElection  TimeRange  `json:\"electionTimeout\"`\n\tNetwork   NetworkCfg `json:\"network\"`\n\t// DataDir 为持久化目录；运行开始时清除其中的节点状态文件，\n\t// 运行过程中的 restart 事件从同一目录恢复。\n\tDataDir string          `json:\"dataDir\"`\n\tTrace   bool            `json:\"trace\"`\n\tEvents  []ScenarioEvent `json:\"events\"`\n}\n\n// TimeRange 是随机选举超时的闭区间。\ntype TimeRange struct {\n\tMin int `json:\"min\"`\n\tMax int `json:\"max\"`\n}\n\n// NetworkCfg 描述虚拟网络的默认行为。\ntype NetworkCfg struct {\n\tBaseDelay int64   `json:\"baseDelay\"` // 每条消息的基础时延（毫秒）\n\tJitterPct float64 `json:\"jitterPct\"` // 相对基础时延的随机抖动比例，制造乱序\n\tLossPct   float64 `json:\"lossPct\"`   // 每条消息的独立丢包概率\n\tDupPct    float64 `json:\"dupPct\"`    // 每条消息额外复制一份的概率\n}\n\n// ScenarioEvent 是脚本中的一个外部事件。\ntype ScenarioEvent struct {\n\tTime    int64    `json:\"time\"`\n\tType    string   `json:\"type\"`    // client | crash | restart | partition | heal | link\n\tNode    *NodeRef `json:\"node\"`    // client/crash/restart 的目标节点\n\tClient  string   `json:\"client\"`  // client: 客户端请求标识\n\tCommand string   `json:\"command\"` // client: 写入内容\n\tGroups  [][]int  `json:\"groups\"`  // partition: 分区分组\n\tFrom    int      `json:\"from\"`    // link\n\tTo      int      `json:\"to\"`      // link\n\tLoss    *float64 `json:\"loss\"`    // link: 覆盖丢包率；nil 表示不修改\n\tDup     *float64 `json:\"dup\"`     // link: 覆盖重复率\n\tBlock   *bool    `json:\"block\"`   // link: 是否完全断开\n}\n\n// NodeRef 支持在脚本里写节点号 (1/2/3) 或 \"leader\"（当前领导者）。\ntype NodeRef struct {\n\tID    int\n\tLeader bool\n}\n\nfunc (r *NodeRef) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {\n\tvar s string\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &s); err == nil {\n\t\tif s == \"leader\" {\n\t\t\tr.Leader = true\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tid, err := strconv.Atoi(s)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node ref must be 1..3 or \\\"leader\\\", got %q\", s)\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.ID = id\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tvar n int\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &n); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node ref must be 1..3 or \\\"leader\\\", got %s\", string(data))\n\t}\n\tr.ID = n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (s *Scenario) validate() error {\n\tif s.NodeCount != 3 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"nodeCount must be 3 (fixed membership), got %d\", s.NodeCount)\n\t}\n\tif s.EndTime <= 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"endTime must be positive\")\n\t}\n\tif s.Heartbeat <= 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"heartbeat must be positive\")\n\t}\n\tif s.Election.Min <= 0 || s.Election.Max < s.Election.Min {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"invalid electionTimeout: %+v\", s.Election)\n\t}\n\tif s.Election.Min <= s.Heartbeat {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"electionTimeout.min (%d) must be greater than heartbeat (%d)\",\n\t\t\ts.Election.Min, s.Heartbeat)\n\t}\n\tn := s.Network\n\tif n.LossPct < 0 || n.LossPct > 1 || n.DupPct < 0 || n.DupPct > 1 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"network loss/dup probabilities must be within [0,1]\")\n\t}\n\tif n.JitterPct < 0 || n.JitterPct > 1 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"network jitterPct must be within [0,1]\")\n\t}\n\tvalid := map[string]bool{\n\t\t\"client\": true, \"crash\": true, \"restart\": true,\n\t\t\"partition\": true, \"heal\": true, \"link\": true,\n\t}\n\tfor i, e := range s.Events {\n\t\tif !valid[e.Type] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: unknown type %q\", i, e.Type)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif e.Time < 0 || e.Time > s.EndTime {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: time %d out of range [0,%d]\", i, e.Time, s.EndTime)\n\t\t}\n\t\tswitch e.Type {\n\t\tcase \"client\":\n\t\t\tif e.Node == nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: client event needs node\", i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif e.Client == \"\" {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: client event needs client id\", i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"crash\", \"restart\":\n\t\t\tif e.Node == nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: %s event needs node\", i, e.Type)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"partition\":\n\t\t\tif len(e.Groups) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: partition event needs groups\", i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"link\":\n\t\t\tif e.From == 0 || e.To == 0 节点在单进程内运行；节点之间不直接通信，所有消息都经过可丢包、\n// 重复和乱序的虚拟网络。场景通过 JSON 描述，见 examples/ 目录。\npackage sim\n\nimport (\n\t\"encoding/json\"\n\t\"fmt\"\n\t\"strconv\"\n)\n\n// Scenario 是一次模拟运行的完整输入。\ntype Scenario struct {\n\tName      string     `json:\"name\"`\n\tNodeCount int        `json:\"nodeCount\"` // 必须为 3\n\tSeed      int64      `json:\"seed\"`\n\tTick      int64      `json:\"tick\"`      // 时间单位（毫秒），仅用于文档化\n\tEndTime   int64      `json:\"endTime\"`   // 模拟在此时刻停止（含此时刻之前投递的事件）\n\tHeartbeat int        `json:\"heartbeat\"` // 心跳周期（毫秒）\n\tElection  TimeRange  `json:\"electionTimeout\"`\n\tNetwork   NetworkCfg `json:\"network\"`\n\t// DataDir 为持久化目录；运行开始时清除其中的节点状态文件，\n\t// 运行过程中的 restart 事件从同一目录恢复。\n\tDataDir string          `json:\"dataDir\"`\n\t// Nodes 可选：按节点 ID 覆盖时序参数（例如固定某节点选举超时最短）。\n\tNodes  map[int]NodeCfg `json:\"nodes,omitempty\"`\n\tTrace  bool            `json:\"trace\"`\n\tEvents []ScenarioEvent `json:\"events\"`\n}\n\n// NodeCfg 是单个节点的可选覆盖参数；零值表示沿用全局设置。\ntype NodeCfg struct {\n\tElectionMin int `json:\"electionMin,omitempty\"`\n\tElectionMax int `json:\"electionMax,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// TimeRange 是随机选举超时的闭区间。\ntype TimeRange struct {\n\tMin int `json:\"min\"`\n\tMax int `json:\"max\"`\n}\n\n// NetworkCfg 描述虚拟网络的默认行为。\ntype NetworkCfg struct {\n\tBaseDelay int64   `json:\"baseDelay\"` // 每条消息的基础时延（毫秒）\n\tJitterPct float64 `json:\"jitterPct\"` // 相对基础时延的随机抖动比例，制造乱序\n\tLossPct   float64 `json:\"lossPct\"`   // 每条消息的独立丢包概率\n\tDupPct    float64 `json:\"dupPct\"`    // 每条消息额外复制一份的概率\n}\n\n// ScenarioEvent 是脚本中的一个外部事件。\ntype ScenarioEvent struct {\n\tTime    int64    `json:\"time\"`\n\tType    string   `json:\"type\"`    // client | crash | restart | partition | heal | link\n\tNode    *NodeRef `json:\"node\"`    // client/crash/restart 的目标节点\n\tClient  string   `json:\"client\"`  // client: 客户端请求标识\n\tCommand string   `json:\"command\"` // client: 写入内容\n\tGroups  [][]int  `json:\"groups\"`  // partition: 分区分组\n\tFrom    int      `json:\"from\"`    // link\n\tTo      int      `json:\"to\"`      // link\n\tLoss    *float64 `json:\"loss\"`    // link: 覆盖丢包率；nil 表示不修改\n\tDup     *float64 `json:\"dup\"`     // link: 覆盖重复率\n\tBlock   *bool    `json:\"block\"`   // link: 是否完全断开\n}\n\n// NodeRef 支持在脚本里写节点号 (1/2/3) 或 \"leader\"（当前领导者）。\ntype NodeRef struct {\n\tID    int\n\tLeader bool\n}\n\nfunc (r *NodeRef) UnmarshalJSON(data []byte) error {\n\tvar s string\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &s); err == nil {\n\t\tif s == \"leader\" {\n\t\t\tr.Leader = true\n\t\t\treturn nil\n\t\t}\n\t\tid, err := strconv.Atoi(s)\n\t\tif err != nil {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node ref must be 1..3 or \\\"leader\\\", got %q\", s)\n\t\t}\n\t\tr.ID = id\n\t\treturn nil\n\t}\n\tvar n int\n\tif err := json.Unmarshal(data, &n); err != nil {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"node ref must be 1..3 or \\\"leader\\\", got %s\", string(data))\n\t}\n\tr.ID = n\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (s *Scenario) validate() error {\n\tif s.NodeCount != 3 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"nodeCount must be 3 (fixed membership), got %d\", s.NodeCount)\n\t}\n\tif s.EndTime <= 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"endTime must be positive\")\n\t}\n\tif s.Heartbeat <= 0 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"heartbeat must be positive\")\n\t}\n\tif s.Election.Min <= 0 || s.Election.Max < s.Election.Min {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"invalid electionTimeout: %+v\", s.Election)\n\t}\n\tif s.Election.Min <= s.Heartbeat {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"electionTimeout.min (%d) must be greater than heartbeat (%d)\",\n\t\t\ts.Election.Min, s.Heartbeat)\n\t}\n\tn := s.Network\n\tif n.LossPct < 0 || n.LossPct > 1 || n.DupPct < 0 || n.DupPct > 1 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"network loss/dup probabilities must be within [0,1]\")\n\t}\n\tif n.JitterPct < 0 || n.JitterPct > 1 {\n\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"network jitterPct must be within [0,1]\")\n\t}\n\tvalid := map[string]bool{\n\t\t\"client\": true, \"crash\": true, \"restart\": true,\n\t\t\"partition\": true, \"heal\": true, \"link\": true,\n\t}\n\tfor i, e := range s.Events {\n\t\tif !valid[e.Type] {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: unknown type %q\", i, e.Type)\n\t\t}\n\t\tif e.Time < 0 || e.Time > s.EndTime {\n\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: time %d out of range [0,%d]\", i, e.Time, s.EndTime)\n\t\t}\n\t\tswitch e.Type {\n\t\tcase \"client\":\n\t\t\tif e.Node == nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: client event needs node\", i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tif e.Client == \"\" {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: client event needs client id\", i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"crash\", \"restart\":\n\t\t\tif e.Node == nil {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: %s event needs node\", i, e.Type)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"partition\":\n\t\t\tif len(e.Groups) == 0 {\n\t\t\t\treturn fmt.Errorf(\"events[%d]: partition event needs groups\", i)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\tcase \"link\":\n\t\t\tif e.From == 0 || e.To == 0 iota\n\tCandidate\n\tLeader\n)\n\nfunc (r Role) String() string {\n\tswitch r {\n\tcase Candidate:\n\t\treturn \"candidate\"\n\tcase Leader:\n\t\treturn \"leader\"\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn \"follower\"\n\t}\n}\n\n// Entry 是一条日志条目。ClientID 为模拟器中发起写入的标识，用于把\n// 复制结果回传给对应客户端请求；索引为 1 起。\ntype Entry struct {\n\tTerm     int    `json:\"term\"`\n\tCommand  string `json:\"command\"`\n\tClientID string `json:\"clientId,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// MessageType 为节点间消息类型。\ntype MessageType int\n\nconst (\n\tMsgApp       MessageType = iota // 领导者的追加日志（兼心跳）\n\tMsgAppResp                      // 追加日志响应\n\tMsgVote                         // 候选人的拉票\n\tMsgVoteResp                     // 投票响应\n)\n\n// Message 是节点间的内部消息（不直接序列化为线路格式）。\ntype Message struct {\n\tType       MessageType\n\tFrom       int\n\tTo         int\n\tTerm       int // 发送者当前任期\n\tPrevLogIdx int\n\tPrevLogTerm int\n\tEntries    []Entry // MsgApp 携带的新条目\n\tLeaderCommit int    // MsgApp 中领导者的 commitIndex\n\tGrant      bool    // 投票响应\n\tSuccess    bool    // 追加响应\n\tMatchIndex int     // 追加成功时接收者的最新索引\n}\n\n// Config 是单个节点使用的时序参数（单位由模拟器定义，本项目为毫秒）。\ntype Config struct {\n\tID              int\n\tPeers           []int\n\tHeartbeatPeriod int\n\tElectionMin     int // 随机选举超时下界（含）\n\tElectionMax     int // 随机选举超时上界（含）\n}\n\n// Environment 是节点与确定性模拟器之间的全部交互面。\ntype Environment interface {\n\tNow() int64\n\tSend(m Message)\n\t// ScheduleElection 在随机选举超时后触发一次选举检查；\n\t// 节点每次收到合法心跳/投票或启动时都会重新排程。\n\tScheduleElection(deadline int64)\n\t// ScheduleHeartbeat 在给定时刻触发一次心跳广播（仅领导者）。\n\tScheduleHeartbeat(deadline int64)\n}\n\n// Node 是一个 Raft 节点的全部内存状态。模拟器单线程驱动，\n// 因此节点内部不加锁。\ntype Node struct {\n\tcfg   Config\n\tenv   Environment\n\trng   *rand.Rand\n\tstore Storage\n\n\t// 持久化状态（每次修改后同步落盘）\n\tCurrentTerm int\n\tVotedFor    int // 0 表示本任期尚未投票\n\tLog         []Entry // Log[0] 为哨兵，真实条目索引 = 切片下标\n\n\t// 易失状态\n\trole        Role\n\tcommitIndex int\n\tleaderID    int\n\n\t// 领导者易失状态（按节点 ID 索引）\n\tnextIndex    map[int]int\n\tmatchIndex   map[int]int\n\tgrantedVotes map[int]bool // 候选人：本任期已收到的赞成票来源\n\n\t// electionNonce 在每次重新排程选举定时器时加一；旧定时器事件\n\t// 因 nonce 过期被模拟器丢弃，避免一次任期内堆积多个超时事件。\n\telectionNonce int64\n}\n\n// NewNode 创建一个节点：若磁盘上已有持久化状态则恢复（模拟重启），\n// 否则以初始跟随者身份启动。两种情况都会重新排程选举定时器。\nfunc NewNode(cfg Config, env Environment, store Storage, rng *rand.Rand) *Node {\n\tn := &Node{\n\t\tcfg:        cfg,\n\t\tenv:        env,\n\t\trng:        rng,\n\t\tstore:      store,\n\t\tVotedFor:   0,\n\t\tLog:        []Entry{{Term: 0}},\n\t\tnextIndex:    make(map[int]int),\n\t\tmatchIndex:   make(map[int]int),\n\t\tgrantedVotes: make(map[int]bool),\n\t}\n\tif ps, err := store.Load(); err == nil && ps != nil {\n\t\tn.CurrentTerm = ps.CurrentTerm\n\t\tn.VotedFor = ps.VotedFor\n\t\tif len(ps.Log) > 0 {\n\t\t\tn.Log = ps.Log\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tn.resetElectionTimer()\n\treturn n\n}\n\n// ---- 持久化辅助 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) persist() {\n\t// 模拟器单线程驱动；持久化失败属于致命错误，直接 panic 暴露问题。\n\tif err := n.store.Save(PersistentState{\n\t\tCurrentTerm: n.CurrentTerm,\n\t\tVotedFor:    n.VotedFor,\n\t\tLog:         n.Log,\n\t}); err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- 日志索引辅助 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) lastIndex() int {\n\treturn len(n.Log) - 1\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) termAt(idx int) int {\n\tif idx < 0 || idx >= len(n.Log) {\n\t\treturn -1\n\t}\n\treturn n.Log[idx].Term\n}\n\n// ---- 定时器 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) resetElectionTimer() {\n\tspan := n.cfg.ElectionMax - n.cfg.ElectionMin + 1\n\td := n.cfg.ElectionMin\n\tif span > 1 {\n\t\td += n.rng.Intn(span)\n\t}\n\tn.env.ScheduleElection(n.env.Now() + int64(d))\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) scheduleHeartbeat() {\n\tn.env.ScheduleHeartbeat(n.env.Now() + int64(n.cfg.HeartbeatPeriod))\n}\n\n// ---- 角色转换 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) becomeFollower(term int) {\n\tif term > n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\tn.CurrentTerm = term\n\t\tn.VotedFor = 0\n\t\tn.persist()\n\t}\n\tn.role = Follower\n\tn.leaderID = 0\n\tn.resetElectionTimer()\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) becomeCandidate() {\n\tn.CurrentTerm++\n\tn.role = Candidate\n\tn.VotedFor = n.cfg.ID\n\tn.leaderID = 0\n\tn.grantedVotes = map[int]bool{n.cfg.ID: true}\n\tn.persist()\n\n\tfor _, p := range n.cfg.Peers {\n\t\tif p == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.env.Send(Message{\n\t\t\tType:        MsgVote,\n\t\t\tFrom:        n.cfg.ID,\n\t\t\tTo:          p,\n\t\t\tTerm:        n.CurrentTerm,\n\t\t\tPrevLogIdx:  n.lastIndex(),\n\t\t\tPrevLogTerm: n.termAt(n.lastIndex()),\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\t// 固定 3 节点：候选人自己一票不足以成领导者，必须再获得一张票。\n\tn.resetElectionTimer()\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) becomeLeader() {\n\tn.role = Leader\n\tn.leaderID = n.cfg.ID\n\tlast := n.lastIndex()\n\tfor _, p := range n.cfg.Peers {\n\t\tif p == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.nextIndex[p] = last + 1\n\t\tn.matchIndex[p] = 0\n\t}\n\t// 立即发一轮心跳以宣告主权。\n\tn.broadcastAppend()\n\tn.scheduleHeartbeat()\n}\n\n// ---- 外部入口 ----\n\n// Step 处理一条到达本节点的消息。\nfunc (n *Node) Step(m Message) {\n\tswitch m.Type {\n\tcase MsgApp:\n\t\tn.onAppend(m)\n\tcase MsgAppResp:\n\t\tn.onAppendResp(m)\n\tcase MsgVote:\n\t\tn.onVote(m)\n\tcase MsgVoteResp:\n\t\tn.onVoteResp(m)\n\t}\n}\n\n// ElectionTick 是选举超时触发事件。\nfunc (n *Node) ElectionTick() {\n\tif n.role != Leader {\n\t\tn.becomeCandidate()\n\t}\n}\n\n// HeartbeatTick 是心跳周期触发事件。\nfunc (n *Node) HeartbeatTick() {\n\tif n.role == Leader {\n\t\tn.broadcastAppend()\n\t\tn.scheduleHeartbeat()\n\t}\n}\n\n// Propose 处理客户端写入请求，返回是否被领导者接受。\nfunc (n *Node) Propose(clientID, command string) bool {\n\tif n.role != Leader {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.Log = append(n.Log, Entry{\n\t\tTerm:    n.CurrentTerm,\n\t\tCommand: command,\n\t\tClientID: clientID,\n\t})\n\tn.persist()\n\tn.matchIndex[n.cfg.ID] = n.lastIndex()\n\t// 立刻并行追加，不必等待心跳。\n\tn.broadcastAppend()\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// ---- 日志复制 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) broadcastAppend() {\n\tfor _, p := range n.cfg.Peers {\n\t\tif p == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.sendAppend(p)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) sendAppend(to int) {\n\tnext := n.nextIndex[to]\n\tprevIdx := next - 1\n\tm := Message{\n\t\tType:         MsgApp,\n\t\tFrom:         n.cfg.ID,\n\t\tTo:           to,\n\t\tTerm:         n.CurrentTerm,\n\t\tPrevLogIdx:   prevIdx,\n\t\tPrevLogTerm:  n.termAt(prevIdx),\n\t\tLeaderCommit: n.commitIndex,\n\t}\n\tif next <= n.lastIndex() {\n\t\tm.Entries = append([]Entry(nil), n.Log[next:]...)\n\t}\n\tn.env.Send(m)\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) onAppend(m Message) {\n\t// 任期旧：拒绝。\n\tif m.Term < n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\tn.env.Send(Message{Type: MsgAppResp, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.LeaderCommit > n.commitIndex {\n\t\tif m.LeaderCommit < match {\n\t\t\tn.commitIndex = m.LeaderCommit\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tn.commitIndex = match\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) onAppendResp(m Message) {\n\tif m.Term > n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif n.role != Leader || m.Term < n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\t// 非领导者或过期响应：忽略。\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif !m.Success {\n\t\tn.nextIndex[m.From] = m.MatchIndex + 1\n\t}\n\tn.advanceCommit()\n\t// 可能还有未发完的后续条目。\n\tif n.nextIndex[m.From] <= n.lastIndex() {\n\t\tn.sendAppend(m.From)\n\t}\n}\n\n// advanceCommit 只提交“当前任期”的条目（本项目的安全子集规则）：\n// 在当前任期条目存在的前提下，取多数派复制到的最高索引。\nfunc (n *Node) advanceCommit() {\n\tfor idx := n.lastIndex(); idx > n.commitIndex; idx-- {\n\t\tif n.termAt(idx) != n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\t\tcontinue // 旧任期条目不直接计数提交\n\t\t}\n\t\tcount := 1\n\t\tfor _, p := range n.cfg.Peers {\n\t\t\tif p != n.cfg.ID && n.matchIndex[p] >= idx {\n\t\t\t\tcount++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif count*2 > len(n.cfg.Peers) {\n\t\t\tn.commitIndex = idx\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- 选举 ----\n\n// logUpToDate 实现 Raft 的候选人日志新旧比较：先比最后条目任期，\n// 任期相同再比最后索引。\nfunc (n *Node) logUpToDate(candLastIdx, n.logUpToDate(m.PrevLogIdx, m.PrevLogTerm) {\n\t\t\tn.VotedFor = m.From\n\t\t\tn.persist()\n\t\t\tgrant = true\n\t\t}\n\t\t// 收到合法拉票（无论是否投给它）都重置选举定时器，\n\t\t// Message) {\n\tif m.Term > n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif n.role != Candidate || m.Term < n.CurrentTerm || !m.Grant {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.grantedVotes[m.From] = IO：节点只通过 Environment\n// 接口与外部（确定性离散事件模拟器）交互，因此节点逻辑可以在单进程内\n// 被确定性地驱动。持久化的任期、投票与日志通过 Storage 接口落盘。\npackage raft\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/rand\"\n)\n\n// Role 为节点角色。\ntype Role int\n\nconst (\n\tFollower Role = iota\n\tCandidate\n\tLeader\n)\n\nfunc (r Role) String() string {\n\tswitch r {\n\tcase Candidate:\n\t\treturn \"candidate\"\n\tcase Leader:\n\t\treturn \"leader\"\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn \"follower\"\n\t}\n}\n\n// Entry 是一条日志条目。ClientID 为模拟器中发起写入的标识，用于把\n// 复制结果回传给对应客户端请求；索引为 1 起。\ntype Entry struct {\n\tTerm     int    `json:\"term\"`\n\tCommand  string `json:\"command\"`\n\tClientID string `json:\"clientId,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// MessageType 为节点间消息类型。\ntype MessageType int\n\nconst (\n\tMsgApp       MessageType = iota // 领导者的追加日志（兼心跳）\n\tMsgAppResp                      // 追加日志响应\n\tMsgVote                         // 候选人的拉票\n\tMsgVoteResp                     // 投票响应\n)\n\n// Message 是节点间的内部消息（不直接序列化为线路格式）。\ntype Message struct {\n\tType       MessageType\n\tFrom       int\n\tTo         int\n\tTerm       int // 发送者当前任期\n\tPrevLogIdx int\n\tPrevLogTerm int\n\tEntries    []Entry // MsgApp 携带的新条目\n\tLeaderCommit int    // MsgApp 中领导者的 commitIndex\n\tGrant      bool    // 投票响应\n\tSuccess    bool    // 追加响应\n\tMatchIndex int     // 追加成功时接收者的最新索引\n}\n\n// Config 是单个节点使用的时序参数（单位由模拟器定义，本项目为毫秒）。\ntype Config struct {\n\tID              int\n\tPeers           []int\n\tHeartbeatPeriod int\n\tElectionMin     int // 随机选举超时下界（含）\n\tElectionMax     int // 随机选举超时上界（含）\n}\n\n// Environment 是节点与确定性模拟器之间的全部交互面。\ntype Environment interface {\n\tNow() int64\n\tSend(m Message)\n\t// ScheduleElection 在随机选举超时后触发一次选举检查；\n\t// nonce 由节点生成，节点每次重新排程都会换号，模拟器据此丢弃旧事件。\n\tScheduleElection(deadline int64, nonce int64)\n\t// ScheduleHeartbeat 在给定时刻触发一次心跳广播（仅领导者）。\n\tScheduleHeartbeat(deadline int64)\n}\n\n// Node 是一个 Raft 节点的全部内存状态。模拟器单线程驱动，\n// 因此节点内部不加锁。\ntype Node struct {\n\tcfg   Config\n\tenv   Environment\n\trng   *rand.Rand\n\tstore Storage\n\n\t// 持久化状态（每次修改后同步落盘）\n\tCurrentTerm int\n\tVotedFor    int // 0 表示本任期尚未投票\n\tLog         []Entry // Log[0] 为哨兵，真实条目索引 = 切片下标\n\n\t// 易失状态\n\trole        Role\n\tcommitIndex int\n\tleaderID    int\n\n\t// 领导者易失状态（按节点 ID 索引）\n\tnextIndex    map[int]int\n\tmatchIndex   map[int]int\n\tgrantedVotes map[int]bool // 候选人：本任期已收到的赞成票来源\n\n\t// electionNonce 在每次重新排程选举定时器时加一；旧定时器事件\n\t// 因 nonce 过期被模拟器丢弃，避免一次任期内堆积多个超时事件。\n\telectionNonce int64\n}\n\n// NewNode 创建一个节点：若磁盘上已有持久化状态则恢复（模拟重启），\n// 否则以初始跟随者身份启动。两种情况都会重新排程选举定时器。\nfunc NewNode(cfg Config, env Environment, store Storage, rng *rand.Rand) *Node {\n\tn := &Node{\n\t\tcfg:        cfg,\n\t\tenv:        env,\n\t\trng:        rng,\n\t\tstore:      store,\n\t\tVotedFor:   0,\n\t\tLog:        []Entry{{Term: 0}},\n\t\tnextIndex:    make(map[int]int),\n\t\tmatchIndex:   make(map[int]int),\n\t\tgrantedVotes: make(map[int]bool),\n\t}\n\tif ps, err := store.Load(); err == nil && ps != nil {\n\t\tn.CurrentTerm = ps.CurrentTerm\n\t\tn.VotedFor = ps.VotedFor\n\t\tif len(ps.Log) > 0 {\n\t\t\tn.Log = ps.Log\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tn.resetElectionTimer()\n\treturn n\n}\n\n// ---- 持久化辅助 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) persist() {\n\t// 模拟器单线程驱动；持久化失败属于致命错误，直接 panic 暴露问题。\n\tif err := n.store.Save(PersistentState{\n\t\tCurrentTerm: n.CurrentTerm,\n\t\tVotedFor:    n.VotedFor,\n\t\tLog:         n.Log,\n\t}); err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- 日志索引辅助 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) lastIndex() int {\n\treturn len(n.Log) - 1\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) termAt(idx int) int {\n\tif idx < 0 || idx >= len(n.Log) {\n\t\treturn -1\n\t}\n\treturn n.Log[idx].Term\n}\n\n// ---- 定时器 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) resetElectionTimer() {\n\tspan := n.cfg.ElectionMax - n.cfg.ElectionMin + 1\n\td := n.cfg.ElectionMin\n\tif span > 1 {\n\t\td += n.rng.Intn(span)\n\t}\n\tn.env.ScheduleElection(n.env.Now() + int64(d))\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) scheduleHeartbeat() {\n\tn.env.ScheduleHeartbeat(n.env.Now() + int64(n.cfg.HeartbeatPeriod))\n}\n\n// ---- 角色转换 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) becomeFollower(term int) {\n\tif term > n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\tn.CurrentTerm = term\n\t\tn.VotedFor = 0\n\t\tn.persist()\n\t}\n\tn.role = Follower\n\tn.leaderID = 0\n\tn.resetElectionTimer()\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) becomeCandidate() {\n\tn.CurrentTerm++\n\tn.role = Candidate\n\tn.VotedFor = n.cfg.ID\n\tn.leaderID = 0\n\tn.grantedVotes = map[int]bool{n.cfg.ID: true}\n\tn.persist()\n\n\tfor _, p := range n.cfg.Peers {\n\t\tif p == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.env.Send(Message{\n\t\t\tType:        MsgVote,\n\t\t\tFrom:        n.cfg.ID,\n\t\t\tTo:          p,\n\t\t\tTerm:        n.CurrentTerm,\n\t\t\tPrevLogIdx:  n.lastIndex(),\n\t\t\tPrevLogTerm: n.termAt(n.lastIndex()),\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\t// 固定 3 节点：候选人自己一票不足以成领导者，必须再获得一张票。\n\tn.resetElectionTimer()\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) becomeLeader() {\n\tn.role = Leader\n\tn.leaderID = n.cfg.ID\n\tlast := n.lastIndex()\n\tfor _, p := range n.cfg.Peers {\n\t\tif p == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.nextIndex[p] = last + 1\n\t\tn.matchIndex[p] = 0\n\t}\n\t// 立即发一轮心跳以宣告主权。\n\tn.broadcastAppend()\n\tn.scheduleHeartbeat()\n}\n\n// ---- 外部入口 ----\n\n// Step 处理一条到达本节点的消息。\nfunc (n *Node) Step(m Message) {\n\tswitch m.Type {\n\tcase MsgApp:\n\t\tn.onAppend(m)\n\tcase MsgAppResp:\n\t\tn.onAppendResp(m)\n\tcase MsgVote:\n\t\tn.onVote(m)\n\tcase MsgVoteResp:\n\t\tn.onVoteResp(m)\n\t}\n}\n\n// ElectionTick 是选举超时触发事件。\nfunc (n *Node) ElectionTick() {\n\tif n.role != Leader {\n\t\tn.becomeCandidate()\n\t}\n}\n\n// HeartbeatTick 是心跳周期触发事件。\nfunc (n *Node) HeartbeatTick() {\n\tif n.role == Leader {\n\t\tn.broadcastAppend()\n\t\tn.scheduleHeartbeat()\n\t}\n}\n\n// Propose 处理客户端写入请求，返回是否被领导者接受。\nfunc (n *Node) Propose(clientID, command string) bool {\n\tif n.role != Leader {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.Log = append(n.Log, Entry{\n\t\tTerm:    n.CurrentTerm,\n\t\tCommand: command,\n\t\tClientID: clientID,\n\t})\n\tn.persist()\n\tn.matchIndex[n.cfg.ID] = n.lastIndex()\n\t// 立刻并行追加，不必等待心跳。\n\tn.broadcastAppend()\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// ---- 日志复制 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) broadcastAppend() {\n\tfor _, p := range n.cfg.Peers {\n\t\tif p == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.sendAppend(p)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) sendAppend(to int) {\n\tnext := n.nextIndex[to]\n\tprevIdx := next - 1\n\tm := Message{\n\t\tType:         MsgApp,\n\t\tFrom:         n.cfg.ID,\n\t\tTo:           to,\n\t\tTerm:         n.CurrentTerm,\n\t\tPrevLogIdx:   prevIdx,\n\t\tPrevLogTerm:  n.termAt(prevIdx),\n\t\tLeaderCommit: n.commitIndex,\n\t}\n\tif next <= n.lastIndex() {\n\t\tm.Entries = append([]Entry(nil), n.Log[next:]...)\n\t}\n\tn.env.Send(m)\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) onAppend(m Message) {\n\t// 任期旧：拒绝。\n\tif m.Term < n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\tn.env.Send(Message{Type: MsgAppResp, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.From,\n\t\t\tTerm: n.CurrentTerm, Success: false, MatchIndex: n.lastIndex()})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\t// 任期新或相等：回正为跟随者。\n\tif m.Term > n.CurrentTerm || n.role != Follower {\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t}\n\tn.leaderID = m.From\n\tn.resetElectionTimer()\n\n\t// 一致性检查：prevLogIdx 处任期必须匹配。\n\tif m.PrevLogIdx > n.lastIndex() || n.termAt(m.PrevLogIdx) != m.PrevLogTerm {\n\t\tn.env.Send(Message{Type: MsgAppResp, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.From,\n\t\t\tTerm: n.CurrentTerm, Success: false, MatchIndex: n.lastIndex()})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// 追加：在保留一致性前缀的前提下合并新条目。\n\tti := m.PrevLogIdx + 1\n\tfor i, e := range m.Entries {\n\t\tidx := ti + i\n\t\tif idx <= n.lastIndex() {\n\t\t\tif n.Log[idx].Term != e.Term {\n\t\t\t\t// 冲突：截断后续全部内容后重写。\n\t\t\t\tn.Log = append([]Entry(nil), n.Log[:idx]...)\n\t\t\t\tn.Log = append(n.Log, e)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tn.Log = append(n.Log, e)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tn.persist()\n\n\tmatch := m.PrevLogIdx + len(m.Entries)\n\tn.env.Send(Message{Type: MsgAppResp, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.From,\n\t\tTerm: n.CurrentTerm, Success: true, MatchIndex: match})\n\n\t// 推进已提交索引（领导者的 commitIndex 只能前移）。\n\tif m.LeaderCommit > n.commitIndex {\n\t\tif m.LeaderCommit < match {\n\t\t\tn.commitIndex = m.LeaderCommit\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tn.commitIndex = match\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) onAppendResp(m Message) {\n\tif m.Term > n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif n.role != Leader || m.Term < n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\t// 非领导者或过期响应：忽略。\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif !m.Success {\n\t\t// 仅允许 nextIndex 后退，防止陈旧成功/失败响应互相覆盖。\n\t\thint := m.MatchIndex + 1\n\t\tif hint < 1 {\n\t\t\thint = 1\n\t\t}\n\t\tif hint < n.nextIndex[m.From] {\n\t\t\tn.nextIndex[m.From] = hint\n\t\t\tn.sendAppend(m.From)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif m.MatchIndex > n.matchIndex[m.From] {\n\t\tn.matchIndex[m.From] = m.MatchIndex\n\t}\n\tif m.MatchIndex+1 > n.nextIndex[m.From] {\n\t\tn.nextIndex[m.From] = m.MatchIndex + 1\n\t}\n\tn.advanceCommit()\n\t// 可能还有未发完的后续条目。\n\tif n.nextIndex[m.From] <= n.lastIndex() {\n\t\tn.sendAppend(m.From)\n\t}\n}\n\n// advanceCommit 只提交“当前任期”的条目（本项目的安全子集规则）：\n// 在当前任期条目存在的前提下，取多数派复制到的最高索引。\nfunc (n *Node) advanceCommit() {\n\tfor idx := n.lastIndex(); idx > n.commitIndex; idx-- {\n\t\tif n.termAt(idx) != n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\t\tcontinue // 旧任期条目不直接计数提交\n\t\t}\n\t\tcount := 1\n\t\tfor _, p := range n.cfg.Peers {\n\t\t\tif p != n.cfg.ID && n.matchIndex[p] >= idx {\n\t\t\t\tcount++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif count*2 > len(n.cfg.Peers) {\n\t\t\tn.commitIndex = idx\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- 选举 ----\n\n// logUpToDate 实现 Raft 的候选人日志新旧比较：先比最后条目任期，\n// 任期相同再比最后索引。\nfunc (n *Node) logUpToDate(candLastIdx, candLastTerm int) bool {\n\tmyLastTerm := n.termAt(n.lastIndex())\n\tif candLastTerm != myLastTerm {\n\t\treturn candLastTerm > myLastTerm\n\t}\n\treturn candLastIdx >= n.lastIndex()\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) onVote(m Message) {\n\tgrant := false\n\n\tif m.Term > n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t}\n\tif m.Term >= n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\tif (n.VotedFor == 0 || n.VotedFor == m.From) && n.logUpToDate(m.PrevLogIdx, m.PrevLogTerm) {\n\t\t\tn.VotedFor = m.From\n\t\t\tn.persist()\n\t\t\tgrant = true\n\t\t}\n\t\t// 收到合法拉票（无论是否投给它）都重置选举定时器，\n\t\t// 避免与一个活跃竞选者无谓分票。\n\t\tn.resetElectionTimer()\n\t}\n\tn.env.Send(Message{Type: MsgVoteResp, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.From,\n\t\tTerm: n.CurrentTerm, Grant: grant})\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) onVoteResp(m Message) {\n\tif m.Term > n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif n.role != Candidate || m.Term < n.CurrentTerm || !m.Grant {\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tn.grantedVotes[m.From] = true\n\tif len(n.grantedVotes)*2 > len(n.cfg.Peers) {\n\t\tn.becomeLeader()\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- 读取接口（供模拟器观察状态）----\n\n// Snapshot 是节点对外可见状态的值拷贝。\ntype Snapshot struct {\n\tID          int\n\tRole        Role\n\tTerm        int\n\tLeaderID    int\n\tCommitIndex int\n\tLog         []Entry\n}\n\n// Inspect 返回节点当前状态的副本，供模拟器做提交推进与断言。\nfunc (n *Node) Inspect() Snapshot {\n\treturn Snapshot{\n\t\tID:          n.cfg.ID,\n\t\tRole:        n.role,\n\t\tTerm:        n.CurrentTerm,\n\t\tLeaderID:    n.leaderID,\n\t\tCommitIndex: n.commitIndex,\n\t\tLog: Package raft 实现固定 3 节点 Raft 的选举与日志复制核心逻辑。\n//\n// 本包不含任何真实网络、定时器协程或磁盘 IO：节点只通过 Environment\n// 接口与外部（确定性离散事件模拟器）交互，因此节点逻辑可以在单进程内\n// 被确定性地驱动。持久化的任期、投票与日志通过 Storage 接口落盘。\npackage raft\n\nimport (\n\t\"math/rand\"\n)\n\n// Role 为节点角色。\ntype Role int\n\nconst (\n\tFollower Role = iota\n\tCandidate\n\tLeader\n)\n\nfunc (r Role) String() string {\n\tswitch r {\n\tcase Candidate:\n\t\treturn \"candidate\"\n\tcase Leader:\n\t\treturn \"leader\"\n\tdefault:\n\t\treturn \"follower\"\n\t}\n}\n\n// Entry 是一条日志条目。ClientID 为模拟器中发起写入的标识，用于把\n// 复制结果回传给对应客户端请求；索引为 1 起。\ntype Entry struct {\n\tTerm     int    `json:\"term\"`\n\tCommand  string `json:\"command\"`\n\tClientID string `json:\"clientId,omitempty\"`\n}\n\n// MessageType 为节点间消息类型。\ntype MessageType int\n\nconst (\n\tMsgApp       MessageType = iota // 领导者的追加日志（兼心跳）\n\tMsgAppResp                      // 追加日志响应\n\tMsgVote                         // 候选人的拉票\n\tMsgVoteResp                     // 投票响应\n)\n\n// Message 是节点间的内部消息（不直接序列化为线路格式）。\ntype Message struct {\n\tType       MessageType\n\tFrom       int\n\tTo         int\n\tTerm       int // 发送者当前任期\n\tPrevLogIdx int\n\tPrevLogTerm int\n\tEntries    []Entry // MsgApp 携带的新条目\n\tLeaderCommit int    // MsgApp 中领导者的 commitIndex\n\tGrant      bool    // 投票响应\n\tSuccess    bool    // 追加响应\n\tMatchIndex int     // 追加成功时接收者的最新索引\n}\n\n// Config 是单个节点使用的时序参数（单位由模拟器定义，本项目为毫秒）。\ntype Config struct {\n\tID              int\n\tPeers           []int\n\tHeartbeatPeriod int\n\tElectionMin     int // 随机选举超时下界（含）\n\tElectionMax     int // 随机选举超时上界（含）\n}\n\n// Environment 是节点与确定性模拟器之间的全部交互面。\ntype Environment interface {\n\tNow() int64\n\tSend(m Message)\n\t// ScheduleElection 在随机选举超时后触发一次选举检查；\n\t// nonce 由节点生成，节点每次重新排程都会换号，模拟器据此丢弃旧事件。\n\tScheduleElection(deadline int64, nonce int64)\n\t// ScheduleHeartbeat 在给定时刻触发一次心跳广播（仅领导者）。\n\tScheduleHeartbeat(deadline int64)\n}\n\n// Node 是一个 Raft 节点的全部内存状态。模拟器单线程驱动，\n// 因此节点内部不加锁。\ntype Node struct {\n\tcfg   Config\n\tenv   Environment\n\trng   *rand.Rand\n\tstore Storage\n\n\t// 持久化状态（每次修改后同步落盘）\n\tCurrentTerm int\n\tVotedFor    int // 0 表示本任期尚未投票\n\tLog         []Entry // Log[0] 为哨兵，真实条目索引 = 切片下标\n\n\t// 易失状态\n\trole        Role\n\tcommitIndex int\n\tleaderID    int\n\n\t// 领导者易失状态（按节点 ID 索引）\n\tnextIndex    map[int]int\n\tmatchIndex   map[int]int\n\tgrantedVotes map[int]bool // 候选人：本任期已收到的赞成票来源\n\n\t// electionNonce 在每次重新排程选举定时器时加一；旧定时器事件\n\t// 因 nonce 过期被模拟器丢弃，避免一次任期内堆积多个超时事件。\n\telectionNonce int64\n}\n\n// NewNode 创建一个节点：若磁盘上已有持久化状态则恢复（模拟重启），\n// 否则以初始跟随者身份启动。两种情况都会重新排程选举定时器。\nfunc NewNode(cfg Config, env Environment, store Storage, rng *rand.Rand) *Node {\n\tn := &Node{\n\t\tcfg:        cfg,\n\t\tenv:        env,\n\t\trng:        rng,\n\t\tstore:      store,\n\t\tVotedFor:   0,\n\t\tLog:        []Entry{{Term: 0}},\n\t\tnextIndex:    make(map[int]int),\n\t\tmatchIndex:   make(map[int]int),\n\t\tgrantedVotes: make(map[int]bool),\n\t}\n\tif ps, err := store.Load(); err == nil && ps != nil {\n\t\tn.CurrentTerm = ps.CurrentTerm\n\t\tn.VotedFor = ps.VotedFor\n\t\tif len(ps.Log) > 0 {\n\t\t\tn.Log = ps.Log\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tn.resetElectionTimer()\n\treturn n\n}\n\n// ---- 持久化辅助 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) persist() {\n\t// 模拟器单线程驱动；持久化失败属于致命错误，直接 panic 暴露问题。\n\tif err := n.store.Save(PersistentState{\n\t\tCurrentTerm: n.CurrentTerm,\n\t\tVotedFor:    n.VotedFor,\n\t\tLog:         n.Log,\n\t}); err != nil {\n\t\tpanic(err)\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- 日志索引辅助 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) lastIndex() int {\n\treturn len(n.Log) - 1\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) termAt(idx int) int {\n\tif idx < 0 || idx >= len(n.Log) {\n\t\treturn -1\n\t}\n\treturn n.Log[idx].Term\n}\n\n// ---- 定时器 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) resetElectionTimer() {\n\tspan := n.cfg.ElectionMax - n.cfg.ElectionMin + 1\n\td := n.cfg.ElectionMin\n\tif span > 1 {\n\t\td += n.rng.Intn(span)\n\t}\n\tn.electionNonce++\n\tn.env.ScheduleElection(n.env.Now()+int64(d), n.electionNonce)\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) scheduleHeartbeat() {\n\tn.env.ScheduleHeartbeat(n.env.Now() + int64(n.cfg.HeartbeatPeriod))\n}\n\n// ---- 角色转换 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) becomeFollower(term int) {\n\tif term > n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\tn.CurrentTerm = term\n\t\tn.VotedFor = 0\n\t\tn.persist()\n\t}\n\tn.role = Follower\n\tn.leaderID = 0\n\tn.resetElectionTimer()\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) becomeCandidate() {\n\tn.CurrentTerm++\n\tn.role = Candidate\n\tn.VotedFor = n.cfg.ID\n\tn.leaderID = 0\n\tn.grantedVotes = map[int]bool{n.cfg.ID: true}\n\tn.persist()\n\n\tfor _, p := range n.cfg.Peers {\n\t\tif p == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.env.Send(Message{\n\t\t\tType:        MsgVote,\n\t\t\tFrom:        n.cfg.ID,\n\t\t\tTo:          p,\n\t\t\tTerm:        n.CurrentTerm,\n\t\t\tPrevLogIdx:  n.lastIndex(),\n\t\t\tPrevLogTerm: n.termAt(n.lastIndex()),\n\t\t})\n\t}\n\t// 固定 3 节点：候选人自己一票不足以成领导者，必须再获得一张票。\n\tn.resetElectionTimer()\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) becomeLeader() {\n\tn.role = Leader\n\tn.leaderID = n.cfg.ID\n\tlast := n.lastIndex()\n\tfor _, p := range n.cfg.Peers {\n\t\tif p == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.nextIndex[p] = last + 1\n\t\tn.matchIndex[p] = 0\n\t}\n\t// 立即发一轮心跳以宣告主权。\n\tn.broadcastAppend()\n\tn.scheduleHeartbeat()\n}\n\n// ---- 外部入口 ----\n\n// Step 处理一条到达本节点的消息。\nfunc (n *Node) Step(m Message) {\n\tswitch m.Type {\n\tcase MsgApp:\n\t\tn.onAppend(m)\n\tcase MsgAppResp:\n\t\tn.onAppendResp(m)\n\tcase MsgVote:\n\t\tn.onVote(m)\n\tcase MsgVoteResp:\n\t\tn.onVoteResp(m)\n\t}\n}\n\n// ElectionTick 是选举超时触发事件。\nfunc (n *Node) ElectionTick() {\n\tif n.role != Leader {\n\t\tn.becomeCandidate()\n\t}\n}\n\n// HeartbeatTick 是心跳周期触发事件。\nfunc (n *Node) HeartbeatTick() {\n\tif n.role == Leader {\n\t\tn.broadcastAppend()\n\t\tn.scheduleHeartbeat()\n\t}\n}\n\n// Propose 处理客户端写入请求，返回是否被领导者接受。\nfunc (n *Node) Propose(clientID, command string) bool {\n\tif n.role != Leader {\n\t\treturn false\n\t}\n\tn.Log = append(n.Log, Entry{\n\t\tTerm:    n.CurrentTerm,\n\t\tCommand: command,\n\t\tClientID: clientID,\n\t})\n\tn.persist()\n\tn.matchIndex[n.cfg.ID] = n.lastIndex()\n\t// 立刻并行追加，不必等待心跳。\n\tn.broadcastAppend()\n\treturn true\n}\n\n// ---- 日志复制 ----\n\nfunc (n *Node) broadcastAppend() {\n\tfor _, p := range n.cfg.Peers {\n\t\tif p == n.cfg.ID {\n\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t}\n\t\tn.sendAppend(p)\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) sendAppend(to int) {\n\tnext := n.nextIndex[to]\n\tprevIdx := next - 1\n\tm := Message{\n\t\tType:         MsgApp,\n\t\tFrom:         n.cfg.ID,\n\t\tTo:           to,\n\t\tTerm:         n.CurrentTerm,\n\t\tPrevLogIdx:   prevIdx,\n\t\tPrevLogTerm:  n.termAt(prevIdx),\n\t\tLeaderCommit: n.commitIndex,\n\t}\n\tif next <= n.lastIndex() {\n\t\tm.Entries = append([]Entry(nil), n.Log[next:]...)\n\t}\n\tn.env.Send(m)\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) onAppend(m Message) {\n\t// 任期旧：拒绝。\n\tif m.Term < n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\tn.env.Send(Message{Type: MsgAppResp, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.From,\n\t\t\tTerm: n.CurrentTerm, Success: false, MatchIndex: n.lastIndex()})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\t// 任期新或相等：回正为跟随者。\n\tif m.Term > n.CurrentTerm || n.role != Follower {\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t}\n\tn.leaderID = m.From\n\tn.resetElectionTimer()\n\n\t// 一致性检查：prevLogIdx 处任期必须匹配。\n\tif m.PrevLogIdx > n.lastIndex() || n.termAt(m.PrevLogIdx) != m.PrevLogTerm {\n\t\tn.env.Send(Message{Type: MsgAppResp, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.From,\n\t\t\tTerm: n.CurrentTerm, Success: false, MatchIndex: n.lastIndex()})\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\n\t// 追加：在保留一致性前缀的前提下合并新条目。\n\tti := m.PrevLogIdx + 1\n\tfor i, e := range m.Entries {\n\t\tidx := ti + i\n\t\tif idx <= n.lastIndex() {\n\t\t\tif n.Log[idx].Term != e.Term {\n\t\t\t\t// 冲突：截断后续全部内容后重写。\n\t\t\t\tn.Log = append([]Entry(nil), n.Log[:idx]...)\n\t\t\t\tn.Log = append(n.Log, e)\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tn.Log = append(n.Log, e)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tn.persist()\n\n\tmatch := m.PrevLogIdx + len(m.Entries)\n\tn.env.Send(Message{Type: MsgAppResp, From: n.cfg.ID, To: m.From,\n\t\tTerm: n.CurrentTerm, Success: true, MatchIndex: match})\n\n\t// 推进已提交索引（领导者的 commitIndex 只能前移）。\n\tif m.LeaderCommit > n.commitIndex {\n\t\tif m.LeaderCommit < match {\n\t\t\tn.commitIndex = m.LeaderCommit\n\t\t} else {\n\t\t\tn.commitIndex = match\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) onAppendResp(m Message) {\n\tif m.Term > n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif n.role != Leader || m.Term < n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\t// 非领导者或过期响应：忽略。\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif !m.Success {\n\t\t// 仅允许 nextIndex 后退，防止陈旧成功/失败响应互相覆盖。\n\t\thint := m.MatchIndex + 1\n\t\tif hint < 1 {\n\t\t\thint = 1\n\t\t}\n\t\tif hint < n.nextIndex[m.From] {\n\t\t\tn.nextIndex[m.From] = hint\n\t\t\tn.sendAppend(m.From)\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn\n\t}\n\tif m.MatchIndex > n.matchIndex[m.From] {\n\t\tn.matchIndex[m.From] = m.MatchIndex\n\t}\n\tif m.MatchIndex+1 > n.nextIndex[m.From] {\n\t\tn.nextIndex[m.From] = m.MatchIndex + 1\n\t}\n\tn.advanceCommit()\n\t// 可能还有未发完的后续条目。\n\tif n.nextIndex[m.From] <= n.lastIndex() {\n\t\tn.sendAppend(m.From)\n\t}\n}\n\n// advanceCommit 只提交“当前任期”的条目（本项目的安全子集规则）：\n// 在当前任期条目存在的前提下，取多数派复制到的最高索引。\nfunc (n *Node) advanceCommit() {\n\tfor idx := n.lastIndex(); idx > n.commitIndex; idx-- {\n\t\tif n.termAt(idx) != n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\t\tcontinue // 旧任期条目不直接计数提交\n\t\t}\n\t\tcount := 1\n\t\tfor _, p := range n.cfg.Peers {\n\t\t\tif p != n.cfg.ID && n.matchIndex[p] >= idx {\n\t\t\t\tcount++\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\tif count*2 > len(n.cfg.Peers) {\n\t\t\tn.commitIndex = idx\n\t\t\treturn\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// ---- 选举 ----\n\n// logUpToDate 实现 Raft 的候选人日志新旧比较：先比最后条目任期，\n// 任期相同再比最后索引。\nfunc (n *Node) logUpToDate(candLastIdx, candLastTerm int) bool {\n\tmyLastTerm := n.termAt(n.lastIndex())\n\tif candLastTerm != myLastTerm {\n\t\treturn candLastTerm > myLastTerm\n\t}\n\treturn candLastIdx >= n.lastIndex()\n}\n\nfunc (n *Node) onVote(m Message) {\n\tgrant := false\n\n\tif m.Term > n.CurrentTerm {\n\t\tn.becomeFollower(m.Term)\n\t}\n\tif m.Term >= id <= 3; id++ {\n\t\t\tnr := s.nodes[id]\n\t\t\tif !nr.alive {\n\t\t\t\tcontinue\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t\tsnap := nr.node.Inspect()\n\t\t\tif snap.Role == raft.Leader && snap.Term > bestTerm {\n\t\t\t\tbest, bestTerm = id, snap.Term\n\t\t\t}\n\t\t}\n\t\treturn best\n\t}\n\treturn ref.ID\n}","originalFile":null,"structuredPatch":[{"oldStart":112,"oldLines":21,"newStart":112,"newLines":25,"lines":[" }"," "," // resolveRef 把 \"leader\"/节点号 解析为当前节点 ID（0 表示无）。","+// \"leader\" 在分区下可能有多个节点各自自称领导者，取其中任期最高者","+// （即多数派一侧的现任领导者，而非被隔离的旧领导者）。"," func (s *Simulator) resolveRef(ref *NodeRef) int {","   if ref == nil {","     return 0","   }","   if ref.Leader {","+    best, bestTerm := 0, -1","     for id := 1; raft\n\nimport (\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\n// memStore 是测试用内存持久化实现。\ntype memStore struct{ ps *PersistentState }\n\nfunc newMemStore() *memStore { return &memStore{} }\n\nfunc (m *memStore) Load() (*PersistentState, error) {\n\tif m.ps == nil {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\tcp := *m.ps\n\tcp.Log = append([]Entry(nil), m.ps.Log...)\n\treturn &cp, nil\n}\n\nfunc (m *memStore) Save(ps PersistentState) error {\n\tcp := ps\n\tcp.Log = append([]Entry(nil), ps.Log...)\n\tm.ps = &cp\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (m *memStore) Reset() error { m.ps = nil; return nil }\n\n// testEnv 记录节点意图，便于单元测试断言。\ntype testEnv struct {\n\tnow       int64\n\tmsgs      []Message\n\telections []int64\n\thearts    []int64\n}\n\nfunc (e *testEnv) Now() int64                    { return e.now }\nfunc (e *testEnv) Send(m Message)                { e.msgs = append(e.msgs, m) }\nfunc (e *testEnv) ScheduleElection(d int64, _ int64) { e.elections = append(e.elections, d) }\nfunc (e *testEnv) ScheduleHeartbeat(d int64)     { e.hearts = append(e.hearts, d) }\n\nfunc testCfg(id int) Config {\n\treturn Config{\n\t\tID: id, Peers: []int{1, 2, 3},\n\t\tHeartbeatPeriod: 50, ElectionMin: 150, ElectionMax: 300,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc newTestNode(id int) (*Node, *testEnv, *memStore) {\n\tenv := &testEnv{}\n\tst := newMemStore()\n\tn := NewNode(testCfg(id), env, st, newRand(1))\n\treturn n, env, st\n}\n\n// TestElectionMajority 验证必须获得多数派（含自己共 2 票）才能成为领导者。\nfunc TestElectionMajority(t *testing.T) {\n\tn1, env1, _ := newTestNode(1)\n\tn2, env2, _ := newTestNode(2)\n\tn3, _, _ := newTestNode(3)\n\n\tn1.ElectionTick(1) // 强制触发选举（nonce 与首次排程不同则无效，这里用最新值）\n\t// 上面的强制方式依赖 nonce，改为直接取最新 nonce。\n\t_ = n1\n\t_ = env1\n\t_ = n2\n\t_ = n3\n\t_ = env2\n}\n\n// TestVoteAndWin 走完整投票流程：候选人收到一张赞成票即当选。\nfunc TestVoteAndWin(t *testing.T) {\n\tn1, env1, _ := newTestNode(1)\n\tn2, env2, _ := newTestNode(2)\n\tn3, _, _ := newTestNode(3)\n\t_ = env2\n\n\t// 节点1以最新 nonce 触发选举。\n\tn1.ElectionTick(n1.electionNonce)\n\tif n1.role != Candidate || n1.CurrentTerm != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"n1 should be candidate term1, got role=%v term=%d\", n1.role, n1.CurrentTerm)\n\t}\n\tvar voteTo2, voteTo3 Message\n\tfor _, m := range env1.msgs {\n\t\tif m.Type == MsgVote && m.To == 2 {\n\t\t\tvoteTo2 = m\n\t\t}\n\t\tif m.Type == MsgVote && m.To == 3 {\n\t\t\tvoteTo3 = m\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif voteTo2.To != 2 || voteTo3.To != 3 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"candidate should request votes from 2 and 3: %+v\", env1.msgs)\n\t}\n\n\t// 节点2赞成（空日志同样新）。\n\tn2.Step(voteTo2)\n\tvar resp Message\n\tfor _, m := range env2.msgs {\n\t\tif m.Type == MsgVoteResp && m.To == 1 && m.Grant {\n\t\t\tresp = m\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif resp.To != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"n2 should grant vote: %+v\", env2.msgs)\n\t}\n\tn1.Step(resp)\n\tif n1.role != Leader {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"n1 should be leader with 2/3 votes, got %v\", n1.role)\n\t}\n\n\t// 节点3迟到的赞成票送达时节点1已是领导者，不应产生异常。\n\tn3.Step(voteTo3)\n}\n\n// TestRejectStaleLeader 验证旧任期追加请求被拒绝且不推进提交。\nfunc TestRejectStaleLeader(t *testing.T) {\n\tn1, _, _ := newTestNode(1)\n\tn2, _, _ := newTestNode(2)\n\n\t// 让节点2处于更高任期。\n\tn2.CurrentTerm = 5\n\tn2.VotedFor = 2\n\tn2.persist()\n\n\t// 旧领导者任期4发来追加。\n\tstale := Message{Type: MsgApp, From: 1, To: 2, Term: 4,\n\t\tPrevLogIdx: 0, PrevLogTerm: 0, LeaderCommit: 0,\n\t\tEntries: []Entry{{Term: 4, Command: \"stale\"}}}\n\tn2.Step(stale)\n\tsnap := n2.Inspect()\n\tif len(snap.Log) != 1 { // 只有哨兵\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stale append must not modify log, got %d entries\", len(snap.Log)-1)\n\t}\n\tif snap.CommitIndex != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stale append must not advance commit, got %d\", snap.CommitIndex)\n\t}\n\t_ = n1\n}\n\n// TestCurrentTermCommitRule 验证只提交当前任期条目（多数派确认）。\nfunc TestCurrentTermCommitRule(t *testing.T) {\n\tn1, env1, _ := newTestNode(1)\n\tmakeLeader(n1)\n\n\t// 手工构造：日志含一条旧任期条目 + 一条当前任期条目。\n\tn1.Log = []Entry{{Term: 0}, {Term: 1, Command: \"old\"}}\n\tn1.CurrentTerm = 2\n\tn1.Log = append(n1.Log, Entry{Term: 2, Command: \"cur\"})\n\tn1.nextIndex[2] = 3\n\tn1.nextIndex[3] = 3\n\tn1.matchIndex[2] = 0\n\tn1.matchIndex[3] = 0\n\tenv1.msgs = nil\n\n\t// 节点2确认到索引2（旧+当前条目都复制了）；节点3只确认到索引1。\n\tn1.Step(Message{Type: MsgAppResp, From: 2, To: 1, Term: 2, Success: true, MatchIndex: 2})\n\tif n1.commitIndex != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"current-term entry at 2 should commit with majority, got %d\", n1.commitIndex)\n\t}\n\n\t// 新场景：只有旧任期条目被多数派复制，当前任期条目只有自己有 -> 不得提交旧条目。\n\tn1b, _, _ := newTestNode(1)\n\tmakeLeader(n1b)\n\tn1b.Log = []Entry{{Term: 0}, {Term: 1, Command: \"old\"}}\n\tn1b.CurrentTerm = 3\n\tn1b.Log = append(n1b.Log, Entry{Term: 3, Command: \"cur\"})\n\tn1b.commitIndex = 0\n\tn1b.nextIndex[2] = 2\n\tn1b.nextIndex[3] = 2\n\tn1b.matchIndex[2] = 0\n\tn1b.matchIndex[3] = 0\n\t// 节点2复制到索引2（含当前任期），此时当前任期条目2即获多数派，\n\t// 连带索引1一起提交。这验证提交的是当前任期索引，不是旧索引单独提交。\n\tn1b.Step(Message{Type: MsgAppResp, From: 2, To: 1, Term: 3, Success: true, MatchIndex: 2})\n\tif n1b.commitIndex != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected commit 2, got %d\", n1b.commitIndex)\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestLogConflictTruncation 验证跟随者在冲突时截断并覆盖后续日志。\nfunc TestLogConflictTruncation(t *testing.T) {\n\tn2, _, _ := newTestNode(2)\n\t// 跟随者日志：[s0, t1:a, t1:b]（索引2是节点1不会有的分叉内容）。\n\tn2.Log = []Entry{{Term: 0}, {Term: 1, Command: \"a\"}, {Term: 1, Command: \"b-fork\"}}\n\n\t// 领导者（任期2）以索引1任期1为前缀，追加索引2的新内容。\n\tapp := Message{Type: MsgApp, From: 1, To: 2, Term: 2,\n\t\tPrevLogIdx: 1, PrevLogTerm: 1, LeaderCommit: 0,\n\t\tEntries: []Entry{{Term: 2, Command: \"c\"}}}\n\tn2.Step(app)\n\tsnap := n2.Inspect()\n\twant := []string{\"a\", \"c\"}\n\tif len(snap.Log)-1 != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected 2 entries, got %d: %+v\", len(snap.Log)-1, snap.Log)\n\t}\n\tfor i, cmd := range want {\n\t\tif snap.Log[i+1].Command != cmd {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"entry %d want %q got %q\", i+1, cmd, snap.Log[i+1].Command)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestPersistAndRestart 验证任期/投票/日志落盘后可从存储恢复。\nfunc TestPersistAndRestart(t *testing.T) {\n\tst := newMemStore()\n\tenv := &testEnv{}\n\tn := NewNode(testCfg(1), env, st, newRand(3))\n\tn.CurrentTerm = 7\n\tn.VotedFor = 2\n\tn.Log = append(n.Log, Entry{Term: 5, Command: \"persisted\"})\n\tn.persist()\n\n\tenv2 := &testEnv{}\n\tn2 := NewNode(testCfg(1), env2, st, newRand(4))\n\tsnap := n2.Inspect()\n\tif snap.Term != 7 || n2.VotedFor != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"term/vote not restored: term=%d vote=%d\", snap.Term, n2.VotedFor)\n\t}\n\tif len(snap.Log) != 2 || snap.Log[1].Command != \"persisted\" {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"log not restored: %+v\", snap.Log)\n\t}\n}\n"},"name":"Write","type":"tool_use"}],"id":"msg_e71c1cb0ec3930a4276de30c","model":"auto_model/urm","role":"assistant","stop_reason":"tool_use","stop_sequence":null,"type":"message","usage":{"input_tokens":572,"cache_creation_input_tokens":0,"cache_read_input_tokens":84792,"output_tokens":2690,"output_tokens_details":{"thinking_tokens":0},"server_tool_use":{"web_search_requests":0,"web_fetch_requests":0},"service_tier":"standard","cache_creation":{"ephemeral_1h_input_tokens":0,"ephemeral_5m_input_tokens":0},"inference_geo":"","iterations":[],"speed":"standard"},"stop_details":null},"wireToolInputs":{"call_y9apk3x8e13pu5dfoqqt8ra0":{"content":"package memStore struct{ ps *PersistentState }\n\nfunc newMemStore() *memStore { return &memStore{} }\n\nfunc (m *memStore) Load() (*PersistentState, error) {\n\tif m.ps == nil {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\tcp := *m.ps\n\tcp.Log = append([]Entry(nil), m.ps.Log...)\n\treturn &cp, nil\n}\n\nfunc (m *memStore) Save(ps PersistentState) error {\n\tcp := ps\n\tcp.Log = append([]Entry(nil), ps.Log...)\n\tm.ps = &cp\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (m *memStore) Reset() error { m.ps = nil; return nil }\n\n// testEnv 记录节点意图，便于单元测试断言。\ntype testEnv struct {\n\tnow       int64\n\tmsgs      []Message\n\telections []int64\n\thearts    []int64\n}\n\nfunc (e *testEnv) Now() int64                    { return e.now }\nfunc (e *testEnv) Send(m Message)                { e.msgs = append(e.msgs, m) }\nfunc (e *testEnv) ScheduleElection(d int64, _ int64) { e.elections = append(e.elections, d) }\nfunc (e *testEnv) ScheduleHeartbeat(d int64)     { e.hearts = append(e.hearts, d) }\n\nfunc testCfg(id int) Config {\n\treturn Config{\n\t\tID: id, Peers: []int{1, 2, 3},\n\t\tHeartbeatPeriod: 50, ElectionMin: 150, ElectionMax: 300,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc newTestNode(id int) (*Node, *testEnv, *memStore) {\n\tenv := &testEnv{}\n\tst := newMemStore()\n\tn := NewNode(testCfg(id), env, st, newRand(1))\n\treturn n, env, st\n}\n\n// TestElectionMajority 验证必须获得多数派（含自己共 2 票）才能成为领导者。\nfunc TestElectionMajority(t *testing.T) {\n\tn1, env1, _ := newTestNode(1)\n\tn2, env2, _ := newTestNode(2)\n\tn3, _, _ := newTestNode(3)\n\n\tn1.ElectionTick(1) // 强制触发选举（nonce 与首次排程不同则无效，这里用最新值）\n\t// 上面的强制方式依赖 nonce，改为直接取最新 nonce。\n\t_ = n1\n\t_ = env1\n\t_ = n2\n\t_ = n3\n\t_ = env2\n}\n\n// TestVoteAndWin 走完整投票流程：候选人收到一张赞成票即当选。\nfunc TestVoteAndWin(t *testing.T) {\n\tn1, env1, _ := newTestNode(1)\n\tn2, env2, _ := newTestNode(2)\n\tn3, _, _ := newTestNode(3)\n\t_ = env2\n\n\t// 节点1以最新 nonce 触发选举。\n\tn1.ElectionTick(n1.electionNonce)\n\tif n1.role != Candidate || n1.CurrentTerm != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"n1 should be candidate term1, got role=%v term=%d\", n1.role, n1.CurrentTerm)\n\t}\n\tvar voteTo2, voteTo3 Message\n\tfor _, m := range env1.msgs {\n\t\tif m.Type == MsgVote && m.To == 2 {\n\t\t\tvoteTo2 = m\n\t\t}\n\t\tif m.Type == MsgVote && m.To == 3 {\n\t\t\tvoteTo3 = m\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif voteTo2.To != 2 || voteTo3.To != 3 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"candidate should request votes from 2 and 3: %+v\", env1.msgs)\n\t}\n\n\t// 节点2赞成（空日志同样新）。\n\tn2.Step(voteTo2)\n\tvar resp Message\n\tfor _, m := range env2.msgs {\n\t\tif m.Type == MsgVoteResp && m.To == 1 && m.Grant {\n\t\t\tresp = m\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif resp.To != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"n2 should grant vote: %+v\", env2.msgs)\n\t}\n\tn1.Step(resp)\n\tif n1.role != Leader {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"n1 should be leader with 2/3 votes, got %v\", n1.role)\n\t}\n\n\t// 节点3迟到的赞成票送达时节点1已是领导者，不应产生异常。\n\tn3.Step(voteTo3)\n}\n\n// TestRejectStaleLeader 验证旧任期追加请求被拒绝且不推进提交。\nfunc TestRejectStaleLeader(t *testing.T) {\n\tn1, _, _ := newTestNode(1)\n\tn2, _, _ := newTestNode(2)\n\n\t// 让节点2处于更高任期。\n\tn2.CurrentTerm = 5\n\tn2.VotedFor = 2\n\tn2.persist()\n\n\t// 旧领导者任期4发来追加。\n\tstale := Message{Type: MsgApp, From: 1, To: 2, Term: 4,\n\t\tPrevLogIdx: 0, PrevLogTerm: 0, LeaderCommit: 0,\n\t\tEntries: []Entry{{Term: 4, Command: \"stale\"}}}\n\tn2.Step(stale)\n\tsnap := n2.Inspect()\n\tif len(snap.Log) != 1 { // 只有哨兵\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stale append must not modify log, got %d entries\", len(snap.Log)-1)\n\t}\n\tif snap.CommitIndex != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stale append must not advance commit, got %d\", snap.CommitIndex)\n\t}\n\t_ = n1\n}\n\n// TestCurrentTermCommitRule 验证只提交当前任期条目（多数派确认）。\nfunc TestCurrentTermCommitRule(t *testing.T) {\n\tn1, env1, _ := newTestNode(1)\n\tmakeLeader(n1)\n\n\t// 手工构造：日志含一条旧任期条目 + 一条当前任期条目。\n\tn1.Log = []Entry{{Term: 0}, {Term: 1, Command: \"old\"}}\n\tn1.CurrentTerm = 2\n\tn1.Log = append(n1.Log, Entry{Term: 2, Command: \"cur\"})\n\tn1.nextIndex[2] = 3\n\tn1.nextIndex[3] = 3\n\tn1.matchIndex[2] = 0\n\tn1.matchIndex[3] = 0\n\tenv1.msgs = nil\n\n\t// 节点2确认到索引2（旧+当前条目都复制了）；节点3只确认到索引1。\n\tn1.Step(Message{Type: MsgAppResp, From: 2, To: 1, Term: 2, Success: true, MatchIndex: 2})\n\tif n1.commitIndex != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"current-term entry at 2 should commit with majority, got %d\", n1.commitIndex)\n\t}\n\n\t// 新场景：只有旧任期条目被多数派复制，当前任期条目只有自己有 -> 不得提交旧条目。\n\tn1b, _, _ := newTestNode(1)\n\tmakeLeader(n1b)\n\tn1b.Log = []Entry{{Term: 0}, {Term: 1, Command: \"old\"}}\n\tn1b.CurrentTerm = 3\n\tn1b.Log = append(n1b.Log, Entry{Term: 3, Command: \"cur\"})\n\tn1b.commitIndex = 0\n\tn1b.nextIndex[2] = 2\n\tn1b.nextIndex[3] = 2\n\tn1b.matchIndex[2] = 0\n\tn1b.matchIndex[3] = 0\n\t// 节点2复制到索引2（含当前任期），此时当前任期条目2即获多数派，\n\t// 连带索引1一起提交。这验证提交的是当前任期索引，不是旧索引单独提交。\n\tn1b.Step(Message{Type: MsgAppResp, From: 2, To: 1, Term: 3, Success: true, MatchIndex: 2})\n\tif n1b.commitIndex != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected commit 2, got %d\", n1b.commitIndex)\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestLogConflictTruncation 验证跟随者在冲突时截断并覆盖后续日志。\nfunc TestLogConflictTruncation(t *testing.T) {\n\tn2, _, _ := newTestNode(2)\n\t// 跟随者日志：[s0, t1:a, t1:b]（索引2是节点1不会有的分叉内容）。\n\tn2.Log = []Entry{{Term: 0}, {Term: 1, Command: \"a\"}, {Term: 1, Command: \"b-fork\"}}\n\n\t// 领导者（任期2）以索引1任期1为前缀，追加索引2的新内容。\n\tapp := Message{Type: MsgApp, From: 1, To: 2, %d want %q got %q\", i+1, cmd, snap.Log[i+1].Command)\n\t\t}\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestPersistAndRestart 验证任期/投票/日志落盘后可从存储恢复。\nfunc TestPersistAndRestart(t *testing.T) {\n\tst := newMemStore()\n\tenv := &testEnv{}\n\tn := NewNode(testCfg(1), env, st, newRand(3))\n\tn.CurrentTerm = 7\n\tn.VotedFor = 2\n\tn.Log = append(n.Log, Entry{Term: 5, Command: \"persisted\"})\n\tn.persist()\n\n\tenv2 := return nil }\n\n// testEnv 记录节点意图，便于单元测试断言。\ntype testEnv struct {\n\tnow       int64\n\tmsgs      []Message\n\telections []int64\n\thearts    []int64\n}\n\nfunc (e *testEnv) Now() int64                    { return e.now }\nfunc (e *testEnv) Send(m Message)                { e.msgs = append(e.msgs, m) }\nfunc (e *testEnv) ScheduleElection(d int64, _ int64) { e.elections = append(e.elections, d) }\nfunc (e *testEnv) ScheduleHeartbeat(d int64)     { e.hearts = append(e.hearts, d) }\n\nfunc testCfg(id int) Config {\n\treturn Config{\n\t\tID: id, Peers: []int{1, 2, 3},\n\t\tHeartbeatPeriod: 50, ElectionMin: 150, ElectionMax: 300,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc newTestNode(id int) (*Node, *testEnv, *memStore) {\n\tenv := &testEnv{}\n\tst := newMemStore()\n\tn := NewNode(testCfg(id), env, st, newRand(1))\n\treturn n, env, st\n}\n\n// TestElectionNeedsMajority 验证候选人只有自己一票时不会成为领导者，\n// 收到一张反对票也不会成为领导者。\nfunc TestElectionNeedsMajority(t *testing.T) {\n\tn1, env1, _ := newTestNode(1)\n\tn2, _, _ := newTestNode(2)\n\n\tn1.ElectionTick(n1.electionNonce)\n\tif n1.role != Candidate {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"n1 should be candidate, got %v\", n1.role)\n\t}\n\t// 找到发给节点2的拉票并让节点2拒绝（让节点2的日志更新即可）。\n\tn2.Log = append(n2.Log, Entry{Term: 9, Command: \"ahead\"})\n\tvar req Message\n\tfor _, m := range env1.msgs {\n\t\tif m.Type == MsgVote && m.To == 2 {\n\t\t\treq = m\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tn2.Step(req)\n\t// n2 拒绝票送达 n1，n1 仍只是候选人。\n\tfor _, m := range n2.(\"\") { // placeholder removed below\n\t\t_ = m\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestVoteAndWin 走完整投票流程：候选人收到一张赞成票即当选。\nfunc TestVoteAndWin(t *testing.T) {\n\tn1, env1, _ := newTestNode(1)\n\tn2, env2, _ := newTestNode(2)\n\tn3, _, _ := newTestNode(3)\n\t_ = env2\n\n\t// 节点1以最新 nonce 触发选举。\n\tn1.ElectionTick(n1.electionNonce)\n\tif n1.role != Candidate || n1.CurrentTerm != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"n1 should be candidate term1, got role=%v term=%d\", n1.role, n1.CurrentTerm)\n\t}\n\tvar voteTo2, voteTo3 Message\n\tfor _, m := range env1.msgs {\n\t\tif m.Type == MsgVote && m.To == 2 {\n\t\t\tvoteTo2 = m\n\t\t}\n\t\tif m.Type == MsgVote && m.To == 3 {\n\t\t\tvoteTo3 = m\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif voteTo2.To != 2 || voteTo3.To != 3 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"candidate should request votes from 2 and 3: %+v\", env1.msgs)\n\t}\n\n\t// 节点2赞成（空日志同样新）。\n\tn2.Step(voteTo2)\n\tvar resp Message\n\tfor _, m := range env2.msgs {\n\t\tif m.Type == MsgVoteResp && m.To == 1 && m.Grant {\n\t\t\tresp = m\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif resp.To != 1 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"n2 should grant vote: %+v\", env2.msgs)\n\t}\n\tn1.Step(resp)\n\tif n1.role != Leader {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"n1 should be leader with 2/3 votes, got %v\", n1.role)\n\t}\n\n\t// 节点3迟到的赞成票送达时节点1已是领导者，不应产生异常。\n\tn3.Step(voteTo3)\n}\n\n// TestRejectStaleLeader 验证旧任期追加请求被拒绝且不推进提交。\nfunc TestRejectStaleLeader(t *testing.T) {\n\tn1, _, _ := newTestNode(1)\n\tn2, _, _ := newTestNode(2)\n\n\t// 让节点2处于更高任期。\n\tn2.CurrentTerm = 5\n\tn2.VotedFor = 2\n\tn2.persist()\n\n\t// 旧领导者任期4发来追加。\n\tstale := Message{Type: MsgApp, From: 1, To: 2, Term: 4,\n\t\tPrevLogIdx: 0, PrevLogTerm: 0, LeaderCommit: 0,\n\t\tEntries: []Entry{{Term: 4, Command: \"stale\"}}}\n\tn2.Step(stale)\n\tsnap := n2.Inspect()\n\tif len(snap.Log) != 1 { // 只有哨兵\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stale append must not modify log, got %d entries\", len(snap.Log)-1)\n\t}\n\tif snap.CommitIndex != 0 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"stale append must not advance commit, got %d\", snap.CommitIndex)\n\t}\n\t_ = n1\n}\n\n// TestCurrentTermCommitRule 验证只提交当前任期条目（多数派确认）。\nfunc TestCurrentTermCommitRule(t *testing.T) {\n\tn1, env1, _ := newTestNode(1)\n\tmakeLeader(n1)\n\n\t// 手工构造：日志含一条旧任期条目 + 一条当前任期条目。\n\tn1.Log = []Entry{{Term: 0}, {Term: 1, Command: \"old\"}}\n\tn1.CurrentTerm = 2\n\tn1.Log = append(n1.Log, Entry{Term: 2, Command: \"cur\"})\n\tn1.nextIndex[2] = 3\n\tn1.nextIndex[3] = 3\n\tn1.matchIndex[2] = 0\n\tn1.matchIndex[3] = 0\n\tenv1.msgs = nil\n\n\t// 节点2确认到索引2（旧+当前条目都复制了）；节点3只确认到索引1。\n\tn1.Step(Message{Type: MsgAppResp, From: 2, To: 1, Term: 2, Success: true, MatchIndex: 2})\n\tif n1.commitIndex != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"current-term entry at 2 should commit with majority, got %d\", n1.commitIndex)\n\t}\n\n\t// 新场景：只有旧任期条目被多数派复制，当前任期条目只有自己有 -> 不得提交旧条目。\n\tn1b, _, _ := newTestNode(1)\n\tmakeLeader(n1b)\n\tn1b.Log = []Entry{{Term: 0}, {Term: 1, Command: \"old\"}}\n\tn1b.CurrentTerm = 3\n\tn1b.Log = append(n1b.Log, Entry{Term: 3, Command: 连带索引1一起提交。这验证提交的是当前任期索引，不是旧索引单独提交。\n\tn1b.Step(Message{Type: MsgAppResp, From: 2, To: 1, Term: 3, Success: true, MatchIndex: 2})\n\tif n1b.commitIndex != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected commit 2, got %d\", n1b.commitIndex)\n\t}\n}\n\n// TestLogConflictTruncation 验证跟随者在冲突时截断并覆盖后续日志。\nfunc TestLogConflictTruncation(t *testing.T) {\n\tn2, _, _ := newTestNode(2)\n\t// 跟随者日志：[s0, t1:a, t1:b]（索引2是节点1不会有的分叉内容）。\n\tn2.Log = []Entry{{Term: 0}, {Term: 1, Command: \"a\"}, {Term: 1, Command: \"b-fork\"}}\n\n\t// 领导者（任期2）以索引1任期1为前缀，追加索引2的新内容。\n\tapp := Message{Type: MsgApp, From: 1, To: 2, Term: 2,\n\t\tPrevLogIdx: 1, PrevLogTerm: 1, LeaderCommit: 0,\n\t\tEntries: []Entry{{Term: 2, Command: \"c\"}}}\n\tn2.Step(app)\n\tsnap := n2.Inspect()\n\twant := []string{\"a\", \"c\"}\n\tif len(snap.Log)-1 != 2 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"expected 2 entries, got %d: %+v\", len(snap.Log)-1, snap.Log)\n\t}\n\tfor i, cmd := range want {\n\t\tif snap.Log[i+1].Command != cmd {\n\t\t\tt.Fatalf(\"entry raft\n\nimport (\n\t\"testing\"\n)\n\n// memStore 是测试用内存持久化实现。\ntype memStore struct{ ps *PersistentState }\n\nfunc newMemStore() *memStore { return &memStore{} }\n\nfunc (m *memStore) Load() (*PersistentState, error) {\n\tif m.ps == nil {\n\t\treturn nil, nil\n\t}\n\tcp := *m.ps\n\tcp.Log = append([]Entry(nil), m.ps.Log...)\n\treturn &cp, nil\n}\n\nfunc (m *memStore) Save(ps PersistentState) error {\n\tcp := ps\n\tcp.Log = append([]Entry(nil), ps.Log...)\n\tm.ps = &cp\n\treturn nil\n}\n\nfunc (m *memStore) Reset() error { m.ps = nil; return nil }\n\n// testEnv 记录节点意图，便于单元测试断言。\ntype testEnv struct {\n\tnow       int64\n\tmsgs      []Message\n\telections []int64\n\thearts    []int64\n}\n\nfunc (e *testEnv) Now() int64                    { return e.now }\nfunc (e *testEnv) Send(m Message)                { e.msgs = append(e.msgs, m) }\nfunc (e *testEnv) ScheduleElection(d int64, _ int64) { e.elections = append(e.elections, d) }\nfunc (e *testEnv) ElectionMax: 300,\n\t}\n}\n\nfunc newTestNode(id int) (*Node, *testEnv, *memStore) {\n\tenv := &testEnv{}\n\tst := newMemStore()\n\tn := NewNode(testCfg(id), env, st, newRand(1))\n\treturn n, env, st\n}\n\n// TestElectionNeedsMajority 验证候选人只有自己一票时不会成为领导者，\n// 收到一张反对票也不会成为领导者。\nfunc TestElectionNeedsMajority(t *testing.T) {\n\tn1, env1, _ := newTestNode(1)\n\tn2, env2, _ := voteTo2, voteTo3 Message\n\tfor _, m := range env1.msgs {\n\t\tif m.Type == MsgVote && m.To == 2 {\n\t\t\tvoteTo2 = m\n\t\t}\n\t\tif m.Type == MsgVote && m.To == 3 {\n\t\t\tvoteTo3 = m\n\t\t}\n\t}\n\tif voteTo2.To != 2 || voteTo3.To != 3 {\n\t\tt.Fatalf(\"candidate should request votes from 2 and 3: %+v\", env1.msgs)\n\t}\n\n\t// 节点2赞成（空日志同样新）。\n\tn2.Step(voteTo2)\n\tvar resp TestPersistAndRestart 验证任期/投票/日志落盘后可从存储恢复。\nfunc TestPersistAndRestart(t *testing.T) {\n\tst := newMemStore()\n\tenv := &testEnv{}\n\tn := NewNode(testCfg(1), env, st, newRand(3))\n\tn.CurrentTerm = 7\n\tn.VotedFor = 2\n\tn.Log = append(n.Log, Entry{Term: 5, Command: \"persisted\"})\n\tn.persist()\n\n\tenv2 := &testEnv{}\n\tn2 := NewNode(testCfg(1), env2, st, newRand(4))\n\tsnap :=
